plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar straight into a Trash settings page, then restore them or delete them permanently.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-trash

Delete sessions from the sidebar into a **Trash** page in Settings, then
restore them or delete them permanently.

A global [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
plugin published as one npm package carrying both halves: a Host plugin mounted
by the bundle patch, and a browser half served from the same package's `./client`
export.

## Install

This package is a DeepSeek Harness **bundle**: `dsh.bundle.patch` is its Host
row, `dsh.client` is its browser half, and the package resolves both. Install it
into a profile with the harness's own Plugin Manager — point it at this
directory (or at the repository URL) and it records the bundle in the profile:

- `dsh` CLI, if the harness exposes the Plugin Manager surface:
  `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <source>`
- or add it to the profile's dependencies and bundle list directly, then boot.

The profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` is applied *after* this bundle's layer, so
it is also where any config below is pinned.

## What it adds

- A delete button at the end of every Session row in the sidebar, beside the
  shipped archive and pin buttons. **One press deletes**: the session goes
  straight to Trash with no confirmation step, because Trash is the undo.
- A **Delete session** row in the Session's `…` menu, for keyboard users and
  anyone who never hovers a row.
- A **Trash** page in Settings listing every deleted session, with
  **Restore** and **Delete permanently** per session and **Empty Trash** for
  the whole list. Permanently deleting a session drops its log and its derived
  projection cache; a live session cannot be trashed or purged. These two stay
  behind a confirmation, because they are the irreversible half.

### The deleted row leaves an open browser immediately

Moving a log aside makes the session absent from the Host catalog on the next
listing — but nothing schedules one. The browser's session store was filled by a
pull that already happened, so a deleted row would otherwise stay on screen (the
sidebar renders it as an ungrouped "stray") until the page was reloaded.

After the log actually moves, the Host therefore emits the declared Remote Event
`api-session/removed`, which Cordis relays to every connected client. That is the
same path the shipped Session controller uses for its own disposal
notifications (`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js`), so the browser clears
the row through its ordinary list-mutation code — no client-side list surgery,
and no plugin knowledge of another package's internals. The route's response
reports `announced: false` if the relay was unavailable, so a deployment without
the event simply falls back to clearing on the next load.

## How deletion works

The Harness ships no session-deletion API: `SessionPersistence` creates, opens,
lists, and flushes handles but never removes one, and the browser session
controller exposes no delete verb. What the store does publish is its
addressing rule — a session is visible exactly when its directory holds a
canonical generation log (`session.jsonl`, `session.v<N>.jsonl`, either with the
configured compression suffix).

So deleting a session appends `.trashed` to that one basename inside the
session's own directory. Nothing is copied and the log's bytes are untouched:
`stat`/`list`/`open` all report the session as absent, so the sidebar catalog,
search, title folding, and lineage traces treat it as gone without knowing this
plugin exists. Restoring removes the suffix again, which brings the title back
with the log, and permanently deleting removes the directory and the session's
projection-cache record.

The trash index is this plugin's own plain JSON document. A missing, empty, or
hand-edited index is reconciled against the session root on every read, so a
trashed session is never stranded by index damage.

## Configuration

The row takes an optional `config`, set from the profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` (the layer applied after this bundle's):

```yaml
- id: session-trash
  name: 'dsh-session-trash'
  config:
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/sessions, the session-persistence root.
    sessionsRoot: /absolute/path/to/sessions
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-session-trash/index.json.
    indexFile: /absolute/path/to/index.json
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions.
    projectionCacheDir: /absolute/path/to/session_projcache/sessions
```

## Verification

Two dependency-free suites ship with the package and run against a scratch
session root in the system temporary directory:

```sh
node verify.mjs        # the store: trash, list, restore, purge, empty, recovery
node verify-route.mjs  # the route: dispatch, validation, refusals, envelopes
```

`verify.mjs` asserts the property this design rests on — a trashed session is
invisible to a canonical-generation scan while its bytes are byte-for-byte
unchanged, and restoring brings back the identical file.

## Upgrade stability

The Host half imports no Harness package; its one contribution is a
`connection.fetch` exact route on the authenticated `/api` channel, and the
store knowledge it relies on is the filename grammar above — a storage-format
constant rather than a module API, with `v<N>` left open-ended so a future
format generation is matched by the same scan. The browser half imports no
Harness Client package either: it uses the module-loader factory contract,
`ctx.slots.inject`/`register`, the slot's standard `useSessions` hook,
`ctx.locale`, and `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens only.

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The plugins.description: DSH 桌面通知：所有前端失焦时把决策 / 授权 / 中断 / 完成发到 Windows 通知中心；点击复用已有页面切回对话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-notify

> 所有 DSH 前端都失焦时，把「需要你决策 / 需要你授权 / 意外中断 / 任务完成」发到 Windows 通知中心；通知标题是会话标题，点击通知复用已打开的 DSH 页面切回对应对话。

![Windows 通知截图](docs/notification.png)

![自绘通知卡片](docs/card.png)

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify
```

重启 `dsh web`，然后硬刷新页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）。也可以从源码安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:CarbonZhao-02692/dsh-desktop-notify`。

## 能力分类

界面与体验。

## 它能做什么

| 事件 | 触发点 | 通知内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 需要你选择决策 | `user-questions/request`（含方案确认 plan-review） | `需要你选择决策：<问题>` |
| 需要你授权 | `approval/request` | `需要你授权：<工具名> — <原因>` |
| 意外中断，请重试 | `turn/end` reason=`error` / `interrupted` / `max-tokens`，以及 `api-session/error` | `任务意外中断：<错误>，请重试` |
| 任务已完成 | `turn/end` reason=`completed` | `任务已完成（用时 X）` |

通知标题取自**对应会话的标题**（`sessionTitle` 服务折叠出的标题）；标题还没生成时回退到该会话第一条用户消息。通知正文是对应提示。

## 焦点判定：所有 DSH 前端都失焦

每个 DSH 页面每 3 秒向 `/dsh-desktop-notify/focus` 上报：

```json
{ "id": "页面 id", "focused": true, "visible": true }
```

`focused = document.visibilityState === 'visible' && document.hasFocus()`。浏览器窗口失焦、切到其他标签页、焦点在地址栏，都会使 `focused` 为 false。

host 的门控只有一条：

- **任意一个页面 `focused=true` → 不是“所有前端失焦”，静默不发。**
- **所有已上报页面 `focused=false` → 发通知。**
- 页面关闭时通过 `sendBeacon` 上报 `closed: true`，立即从汇总移除。
- 后台标签页的定时器可能被浏览器节流，所以 3 分钟内没有心跳才按已关闭处理；所有页面都关闭时视为“全部失焦”。

`visible` 只用于状态展示，不参与门控。

## 通知模式与点击回到对话

配置项 `enableCard` 决定通知形态：

### `enableCard: false`（默认）

只显示正常的 Windows toast，不显示自绘卡片：

1. toast 带 `activationType="protocol"` 和 `launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=<id>&origin=<origin>"`；Windows 调用协议 helper `assets/open.ps1`。
2. 同时启动 `assets/toast-listener.ps1`，在隐藏 PowerShell 进程里保持 `ToastNotification` 存活；如果 `Activated` 事件被投递，也会调用同一个 helper。
3. helper 把会话 id POST 到 host 的 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activate`，用 `ShowWindow` / `SetForegroundWindow` 恢复并置前 Edge/Chrome 窗口（只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化保持不变）。
4. helper 通过 UI Automation 把标题匹配的 DSH 标签页切到前台；已打开的 DSH 页面每秒轮询 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activation`，收到后调用 `uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)`。
5. host 只把请求投递给**用户最后使用的那个页面**，多标签不会一起跳。

### `enableCard: true`

只显示右下角原生 WPF 卡片，不发送任何 Windows toast：

1. host 启动 `assets/notify-card.ps1`，显示应用名、鲸鱼图标、会话标题和正文，不抢焦点，20 秒后自动关闭。
2. 点击卡片调用 `assets/open.ps1`，后续的激活、窗口恢复、标签页切换与上面相同。
3. 不使用浏览器通知；通知中心不会留下记录。

**没有页面时的兜底**：如果 host 发现没有任何已连接的 DSH 页面，会让 helper 在默认浏览器打开一个引导页；引导页把会话 id 写入 `localStorage` 并跳回 DSH，新页面加载后自动打开对应对话。

## 设置页与测试

DSH 设置 → 通用 → **桌面通知**：

- 显示当前上报页面数和焦点汇总状态（有前端聚焦 = 静默中 / 全部失焦 = 会通知）。
- “自绘卡片”开关：切换 `enableCard`，立即生效并持久化到 `%DSH_HOME%\super-injector\dsh-desktop-notify-config.json`；关闭则只发 Windows toast，打开则只显示可点击卡片。
- “发送测试通知”按钮：强制发一条通知，忽略焦点门控，用来验证当前模式、应用名、图标与点击行为。

也可以直接调用 HTTP 接口：

```powershell
# 查看焦点状态与最近通知
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/status

# 强制发一条测试通知（force 忽略焦点门控；带 sessionId 时点击会回到该对话）
$body = @{ kind='complete'; force=$true; sessionId='session-...'; body='测试通知' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' `
  -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) `
  http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/test
```

## 配置

默认值在 `lib/index.js` 的 `DEFAULTS` 里；通过 loader 行的 `config` 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-desktop-notify
  name: '@carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify'
  config:
    onlyWhenUnfocused: true   # false = 页面聚焦时也发
    clickToOpen: true         # false = 通知不可点击回会话
    enableCard: false         # true = 仅自绘卡片；false = 仅普通 Windows toast
    ignoreSubagent: true      # 后台子代理会话不提醒
    notifyOnDecision: true
    notifyOnApproval: true
    notifyOnInterruption: true
    notifyOnComplete: true
    minTurnDurationMs: 0      # 完成提醒的最短轮次时长（毫秒）
    toastAppId: 'DeepSeek.DSH.Notify'
    toastAppName: 'Deepseek Harness Notification'
    toastIconPath: ''         # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.png
    toastAppIconPath: ''      # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.ico
```

## 兼容与运行要求

- DSH `web` profile；实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`（当前 checkout）。
- Windows 10 / 11，Windows PowerShell 5.1（WinRT toast）。
- Node.js >= 20。
- 页面必须保持打开才能上报焦点；没有页面时点击通知会走兜底新开页。
- 浏览器 / DSH Desktop 需要允许 Windows 通知；系统“专注助手”可能拦截。
- 仅实现 Windows toast；其他平台只写日志、不发通知。

## 权限与外部服务

- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify`（自定义协议 helper）。
- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\DeepSeek.DSH.Notify`（应用名与图标）。
- toast 模式会注册 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify` 协议；卡片模式不发送 toast，也不注册协议。
- 通过 `powershell.exe` 显示 toast 或卡片，并在临时目录写一个 `.ps1` 脚本。
- helper 使用 Windows UI Automation 查找并切换浏览器标签页（不需要管理员权限）。
- 本机 HTTP 路由：`/focus`、`/status`、`/test`、`/activate`、`/activation`、`/open`；其中 `/activate` 和 `/open` 只接受 loopback 请求，`/open` 还需要每次进程随机生成的密钥。
- 没有外部服务、没有上传、没有网络请求（除本机 DSH 地址）。

## 真实输出

### toast 模式（`enableCard: false`）

```xml
<toast activationType="protocol" launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...&origin=http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A3080">
  <visual><binding template="ToastGeneric">
    <text>示例会话标题</text>
    <text>点击通知应回到对应对话</text>
    <image placement="appLogoOverride" src="file:///.../assets/deepseek-harness.png"/>
  </binding></visual>
  <audio src="ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Default"/>
</toast>
```

### 卡片模式（`enableCard: true`）

```text
shown
clicked
start uri=dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...
activate hwnd=... minimized=False maximized=True foreground=True
tab selected: 示例会话标题 — DeepSeek Harness ...
activation queued session=session-... target=dsh-... live=1
activation delivered session=session-... client=dsh-...
```

## 已知限制

- 后台子代理会话默认不提醒（它们的完成由主对话那一轮覆盖）。
- `enableCard: false` 时通知中心里的 toast 点击是否触发协议/Activated 取决于 Windows 环境；当前这台 Windows 10 上两者都未触发。
- `enableCard: true` 时可点击的是右下角原生卡片；卡片 20 秒后自动关闭。
- 窗口恢复/置前对 Edge/Chrome 使用 Win32 `ShowWindow` + `SetForegroundWindow`；只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化窗口保持最大化。系统前台锁定、虚拟桌面切换等极端情况仍可能失败。
- 标签页切换 / 窗口激活目前针对 Edge / Chrome；DSH 在 Firefox 中时不会自动切回该标签页。
- 标签页切换按标题匹配；多个标签页标题相同时，可能选中同标题的另一个 DSH 标签页（仍会落在对应会话）。
- helper 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-helper.log`；卡片日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-card.log`；toast listener 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-toast.log`。
- Windows 可能缓存 AUMID 的应用名/图标；重启 Explorer 或清空通知历史后会刷新。

## 开发

插件是纯 ESM/CJS JavaScript，无构建步骤、无第三方运行时依赖。

- host：[lib/index.js](lib/index.js)
- client：[lib/client.js](lib/client.js)
- 协议 helper：[assets/open.ps1](assets/open.ps1)
- toast listener：[assets/toast-listener.ps1](assets/toast-listener.ps1)
- 原生通知卡片：[assets/notify-card.ps1](assets/notify-card.ps1)
- 图标：[assets/deepseek-harness.png](assets/deepseek-harness.png)、[assets/deepseek-harness.ico](assets/deepseek-harness.ico)
- 条目：[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)

本地修改后重新加载插件或重启 DSH。

## License

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

图标来自官方 DSH 前端资源（MIT）；DeepSeek Harness 与鲸鱼标识归各自所有者，本插件非官方出品。见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pending-review-glow

给左侧会话列表的每一行加状态高亮，三种状态共用同一套「内描边 + 淡底」视觉语言，只用颜色和动效区分：

| 状态 | 颜色 | 动效 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pending` | 红 `rgba(244,63,94,…)` | 呼吸 1.5s | 有审批在等你 |
| `running` | 黄 `rgba(245,158,11,…)` | **常亮，不呼吸** | 推理/运行中 |
| `finished` | 绿 `rgba(34,197,94,…)` | 呼吸 1.5s | 刚跑完、不需要审核、且自那以后没点开过 |

优先级：红 > 黄 > 绿。行尾同时有一个同色小圆点（黄点常亮，红/绿点呼吸），作为槽位可见时更明确的提示。

- 包名 / 插件行 id：`dsh-pending-review-glow` / `pending-review-glow`
- 零依赖、零构建；浏览器半是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })` 的 classic script
- 安装：插件页「添加插件」填本目录绝对路径（链接安装，改文件后重启即生效）

## 数据来源（全部是 emit 广播，无调用顺序问题）

| 状态 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 待审核 | 会话审计事件 `approval/asked` / `approval/decided`（另用 `approval/request` + `prepend` 交叉校验） |
| 运行中 | `api-session/status(sessionId, running)` |
| 刚完成 | 同上，`running: true → false` 时记录时间戳 |

`approval/request` 监听器始终 `next()` 透传，不认领、不改写、不改超时任何审批。

## 路由

```
GET /pending-review-glow/state
{"revision":7,"seen":1,"asks":2,"count":1,
 "pending":[{"sessionId":"…","count":1,"tool":"…","since":…}],
 "running":["…"],
 "finished":[{"sessionId":"…","at":1760000000000}]}
```

- `asks`：累计 `approval/asked` 次数；`decided`：累计 `approval/decided` 次数；`seen`：`approval/request` 监听器执行次数；`count`：当前待审核会话数
- `recent`：最近 10 条与审批相关的事件类型（`approval/asked`、`approval/decided`、`turn/end`），排查"红色不灭"时看它
- 兜底：收到 `turn/end` 时强制清空该会话的 `asks` / `live` —— 审批是回合内封闭的，回合结束不可能还有未结审批
- 浏览器半按 `revision` 判重，`revision` 不变就不重渲染

## 绿色怎么消失

`finished` 只代表「跑完过」。浏览器半在两种情况下把 `sessionId → Date.now()` 写进 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-pending-review-glow:ack`），只要 `ack ≥ finished.at` 就不再绿，直到它下一次跑完刷新时间戳：

1. **该行被点击（pointerdown）** —— 你主动切过去看结果；
2. **跑完的那一刻该行正被选中** —— 你本来就开着它在看它跑完，算已看过。这条修复了"一直选中 → 跑完 → 切走 → 原行又变绿"的 bug。

另外为了让"你正打开的那个会话"不显示绿色，还会检查行元素上的高置信选中标记（`aria-selected="true"`、`aria-current="true|page"`、class 里的 `active|selected`）。**若这些标记都没命中**，当前会话跑完时也会短暂显示绿色，点它一次即可清除——这是已知的、可接受的近似。

## 渲染方式

浏览器半轮询路由（页面可见 400ms、切后台 3s，切回前台立刻补一次；请求不重叠），通过槽位 `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action`（每个会话行都会挂载）放探针组件：

- 探针沿 DOM 向上定位所在行（高 20–72px、宽 ≥100px），给行加 `data-dsh-session-state="pending|running|finished"`
- 样式由组件内联的 `<style>` 提供（卸载即失效），每 2s 重申一次属性防 React 冲掉
- `prefers-reduced-motion` 下红/绿呼吸自动降级为常亮描边

## 实测记录（2026-10-17）

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 安装（插件页填本地目录） | 成功（链接到 `plugins/dsh-pending-review-glow`） |
| 无审批时 `/state` | `{revision:0,seen:0,asks:0,count:0,pending:[]}` |
| 审批悬置时 `/state` | `{revision:2,seen:1,asks:1,count:1,pending:[1]}` |
| 红色呼吸 + 行尾红点 | 用户确认生效 |
| 绿色呼吸 + 点击清除 | 用户确认生效 |

**踩过的坑（已修）**：三态改造时把 `running` 的会话 id 混进了 `pending` 列表，导致**运行中的行一律显示红色**。证据是那一刻的路由快照：`asks:0, decided:0, seen:0` 却 `count:1`，且 `pending` 那条记录的 `count` 是 0。现已把 `running` 从 `pending` 的 id 集合中移除，`running` 只出现在自己的字段里。


**已实测**：两条审批数据源、红色状态。
**待实测**（本轮新增）：黄色常亮（运行中）、绿色呼吸（跑完未点开）、点击后绿色消失、审批结算后红色熄灭。
**数据源风险**：`api-session/status` 若在某些装配下不广播，黄/绿不会出现——用下面的自检命令能立刻看出。

## 自检

```js
await (await fetch('/pending-review-glow/state')).json()
```

```js
document.querySelectorAll('[data-dsh-session-state]').length
```

## 卸载

插件页找到 `dsh-pending-review-glow` → 卸载 → 重启 DSH。清掉绿色记忆：Console 执行 `localStorage.removeItem('dsh-pending-review-glow:ack')`。

plugins.description: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的全局 UI 缩放插件。类似于 VS Code 的窗口缩放机制，支持将整个界面等比例缩放至 80%、110%、125%、150% 等任意比例。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ui-zoom 界面缩放插件

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

> 适用于 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的全局 UI 缩放插件。类似于 VS Code 的窗口缩放机制，支持将整个界面等比例缩放至 80%、110%、125%、150% 等任意比例。

![UI 缩放图标](icon.svg)

---

## ✨ 功能特性

- 🔍 **等比整体缩放**：不同于单纯修改字体字号，本插件成比例缩放整个应用界面的所有元素（包括侧边栏、输入区域、按钮、对话卡片、间距、图标及字体）。
- ⚙️ **无缝融入设置面板**：自动注册至「**设置 -> 通用**」，紧跟在「字号」选项下方。
- 🎛️ **常用预设与微调**：
  - 常用预设快捷按钮：`80%`、`90%`、`100%`、`110%`、`125%`、`150%`。
  - 步进器按钮（`−` / `+`）支持平滑微调。
  - 一键 **重置 (100%)** 按钮。
- ⌨️ **全局快捷键支持**（VS Code 习惯）：
  - **`Ctrl` + `=`** 或 **`Ctrl` + `+`**（macOS 上为 `Cmd`）：放大界面。
  - **`Ctrl` + `-`**（macOS 上为 `Cmd`）：缩小界面。
  - **`Ctrl` + `0`**（macOS 上为 `Cmd`）：一键重置为 100%。
  - **`Ctrl` + 鼠标滚轮**：按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮快速连续缩放。
- 🧭 **即时 HUD 提示**：使用快捷键或滚轮调整缩放时，屏幕右下角自动浮现半透明提示框展示当前缩放百分比。
- 🎯 **完美解决浮层错位（Double-Zoom Fix）**：内置视口坐标空间校准机制，解决 CSS `zoom` 下通过 `createPortal` 挂载的弹出菜单（如左下角用户名菜单、下拉选择器、工具提示等）位置错位或悬空的问题，始终精准贴合。
- 💾 **自动持久化**：缩放配置自动保存在本地缓存中，刷新页面或下次启动时自动恢复。

---

## 📦 安装方式

### 方式 1：本地仓库安装（推荐）

1. 将本仓库克隆至你的工作区或本地目录：
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<你的用户名>/dsh-ui-zoom.git
   ```

2. 在 DSH 终端中使用 CLI 或通过 Plugin Manager 安装到当前 Profile：
   ```bash
   dsh profile install-bundle /path/to/dsh-ui-zoom
   ```
   *也可以直接在 DSH 对话框中让助手安装：*
   > “请帮我安装工作区下的 dsh-ui-zoom 插件”

3. 刷新 DSH 窗口（`Ctrl + R` 或 `F5`）即可立即生效。

### 方式 2：通过 npm 安装（若已发布）

如果将该包发布至 npm（例如 `dsh-ui-zoom`）：
```bash
dsh profile install-bundle dsh-ui-zoom
```

---

## 🚀 使用指南

### 方式 1：从设置面板调节
1. 点击左下角齿轮「**设置**」。
2. 点击「**通用**」选项卡。
3. 找到「**界面缩放**」，直接点击常用预设比例或使用 `+` / `−` 进行调整。

### 方式 2：使用快捷键
- 按 `Ctrl + =` 放大。
- 按 `Ctrl + -` 缩小。
- 按 `Ctrl + 0` 恢复默认大小。
- 按住 `Ctrl` 滚动鼠标滚轮放大/缩小。

---

## 🛠️ 项目结构

```text
dsh-ui-zoom/
├── package.json          # 插件清单与配置
├── cordis.patch.yml      # DSH Cordis 编排补丁
├── index.js              # Host 端入口
├── client.js             # Client 端渲染逻辑、DOM 缩放与坐标修复
├── icon.svg              # 矢量图标
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json           # 简体中文文案与元数据
│   └── en.json           # 英文文案与元数据
├── LICENSE               # MIT 开源许可证
├── README.md             # 默认中文说明文档
└── README.en.md          # 英文说明文档
```

---

## 📄 开源许可证

本项目采用 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH 免重启热刷新插件：监视插件源码变化，重新加载 host 侧插件模块并刷新 Web 界面，让插件更新立刻生效，无需重启桌面端。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-live-reload

让 **DSH 不重启就能生效**：插件源码一变，host 侧插件模块立刻重新加载；会话标题栏右侧还有一颗「刷新界面」按钮，点一下就把浏览器里的旧页面换成新的。

装好本插件并重启一次之后，**其它插件**的改动都不再需要重启 DSH —— 改完代码 1 秒内自动生效，页面点一下按钮（或按策略自动）刷新。

- 零依赖、零构建（host 半边与浏览器半边都是手写 CommonJS/ESM）
- 只用宿主公开契约（`ctx.tools` / `loader` / `webServer` / `ctx.slots` / `ctx.provide`）
- 兼容 **DSH 0.2.1**（`engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.1`）
- 监视走轮询而不是 `fs.watch`（见下文「为什么不用 fs.watch」）

---

## 1. 它做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 热重载 host 插件模块 | 监视 profile 里用 `link:` 装入的插件目录，磁盘一变就重新 import 对应模块并重新 `apply`，等价于宿主内置 HMR 的那套「清缓存 → 重 import → 换 registry 绑定」 |
| 刷新按钮（浏览器半边） | 注册到会话标题栏右侧（`conversation.session.header.utilities`）的 28×28 图标按钮：点击 → 先让 host 比对一次磁盘并热重载 → `location.reload()`。Shift / Alt + 点击 = 只刷新页面、不做检查 |
| 更新提示 | 按钮常驻轮询 `/__dsh-live-reload/state`；`rev` 变了就在按钮右上角点一颗品牌色小圆点（`refreshUi: auto` 且用户空闲时自动刷新，忙时不打断输入） |
| 工具入口 | 工具 `live_reload`：`status` / `check` / `reload` / `start` / `stop` / `roots` / `cache` |
| 服务入口 | 服务 `liveReload`，供其它插件订阅 `onChange` 或主动触发重载 |

**边界**（务必先读）：

- 管 **host 半边**（Node 里跑的插件模块）+ **一颗页面刷新按钮**。浏览器 bundle 的替换由宿主自己的 client-modules 负责，本插件负责让页面重新拉取它。
- 只管 **`link:` 装入的插件目录**（开发/自研插件正是这种）。DSH 自带的插件在 `app.asar` 里，不在监视范围。
- 默认**不重载自己**（`reloadSelf: false`）：改本插件源码时请手动重启一次，避免自己把自己换掉。
- 不会把 `disabled` 的插件顶起来：自动路径按「只重载本来就在跑的 entry」处理；显式 `action=reload` 才允许强制。

## 2. 安装

```powershell
# 装进桌面 profile（本机示例路径，换成你自己的插件目录）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:/path/to/dsh-live-reload
```

或者直接用插件管理器：`plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<插件目录绝对路径>`。

装完 **重启一次 DSH**（让本插件自己先跑起来）。此后改别的插件 → 不用重启；页面按一次刷新按钮即可。

## 3. 工具 `live_reload`

| action | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | 看监视了哪些目录、对应哪些 loader entry、最近重载记录、界面刷新状态、统计 |
| `check` | 立刻比对一次磁盘指纹；有变化就重载（不用等轮询） |
| `reload` | 立即重载。可带 `target` / `targets` 子串筛选；不带就重载所有被监视插件 |
| `start` / `stop` | 开/关自动监视（`stop` 之后手动 `reload`/`check` 仍可用） |
| `roots` | 只列监视目录与来源 |
| `cache` | 诊断：把宿主模块缓存里的键摊开（ESM/CJS 各有多少、命中哪些、`loader.internal` 是否可用）。排查「报告成功但代码没换」时先看它 |

典型用法：改完代码发现还没生效（比如刚写的文件 mtime 太新、或插件本身被排除），直接

```
live_reload( action = "reload", target = "dsh-image-insight" )
```

## 4. 配置

写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（或插件设置界面）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-live-reload
  name: dsh-live-reload
  config:
    pollMs: 400              # 扫描间隔，默认 700ms（150–60000）
    debounceMs: 300          # 变更去抖，默认 300ms（50–10000）
    autoWatch: true          # 是否自动监视
    reloadSelf: false        # 是否允许热重载本插件
    refreshUi: auto          # auto|always|manual|never（auto=空闲时自动刷新）
    uiPollMs: 1500           # 按钮轮询 /state 的间隔（500–60000）
    watch:                   # 额外监视的目录（绝对路径）
      - D:/test-dsh/experiments/lr-victim
    exclude:                 # 排除的目录
      - D:/test-dsh/scratch
    reloadTargets:           # 白名单：只有命中的插件才会被（自动）重载
      - dsh-image-insight
    ignore:                  # 追加忽略规则（在默认列表之上）
      - '*.tmp'
```

默认忽略：`node_modules`、`.git`、`.github`、`dist`、`build`、`out`、`coverage`、`.cache`、`.turbo`、`.next`、`*.log`、`*.tmp`、`*.swp`、`*~`、`.DS_Store`。

## 5. 服务 `liveReload`

```js
// 在其它插件里
const live = ctx.get('liveReload');
const off = live.onChange((items) => console.log('热重载完成', items));
await live.reload({ target: 'my-plugin' });   // 立刻重载
live.status();                                 // 与工具 status 同一份数据
live.roots();                                  // 监视目录数组
```

## 6. 界面刷新怎么工作

两个半边各司其职：

**host 半边**（`lib/index.js`，延迟注入 webServer）：

- `ctx.inject(['webServer'], (sub) => sub.effect(() => webServer.register(...)))` —— 0.2.x 里 `apply` 阶段拿不到 `webServer`（提供者 fiber 还没 ACTIVE），必须等依赖就绪；不 `inject` 声明只 `ctx.get()` 会静默失败（旧 0.1.0 就是这么 404 的）。
- `GET /__dsh-live-reload/state` → `{ rev, at, items, startedAt, roots, stats, ui }`（几十字节 JSON，`no-store`）
- `GET /__dsh-live-reload/check` → 先比对磁盘、必要时热重载，再返回结果（按钮点击时调用）
- `GET /__dsh-live-reload/reload` → 强制重载一次

**浏览器半边**（`lib/client.js`，手写 lazy-CJS，`dsh.client.immediately: true`）：

- `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.session.header.utilities', …)` 注册 `dsh-live-reload:refresh`（`order: 30`，排在 better-sidebar 的 10/20 之后）。
- 组件自己轮询 `/state`；`rev` 变化 → 按钮变品牌色 + 小圆点；`refreshUi: auto` 且当前焦点不在输入框 → 600ms 后自动 `location.reload()`。
- 为什么刷新要由页面发起：0.2.x 全库没有 `location.reload()`，宿主只能通过 SSE 通知「这个 bundle 换了」，页面自己决定何时换。

> 为什么不往 index.html 注入脚本：桌面壳的 `index.html` 由安装包静态 dist 直出，`tapIndex` 不参与渲染；`webserver/index-inject` 的结构化行只在宿主启动时收集一次、之后没有刷新路径。client half 才是 0.2.x 的正式通道。

## 7. 实现要点（为什么这么写）

1. **必须「先删 registry，再 apply 新模块」**。宿主 `Fiber.dispose` 里有一句
   `if (this.ctx.registry.has(runtime.callback))`：如果先 dispose 旧 fiber 再删 registry，Loader 的
   `internal/plugin` 监听会走到 case 6，把 entry 写成 `disabled: true` 并持久化 —— 插件从此不再加载。
   顺序错了就是这个后果，所以代码里把它写成显式步骤并加了断言测试。
2. **必须清 Node 的模块缓存**。ESM/CJS 缓存不清，重新 import 拿到的还是旧模块（Node 24 的 LoadCache 用 `Map`，
   而且它的 `delete` 只是把槽位置空，所以用 `Map.prototype.delete.call()`）。
   而且**键未必是监视目录的路径**：`link:` 装入的插件在宿主里的模块标识常常是
   `<profile>/node_modules/<pkg>/...`（junction 路径），与配置里监视的真实目录字面不同。
   所以匹配同时用四层线索：路径前缀、realpath 穿透、目录 basename、插件包名。
   真机上「一次都没有清掉」曾导致**报告成功但代码没换**，这正是 `cache` action 存在的原因。
2.5. **清不掉缓存时退化为「带版本号重新导入」**：给模块 URL 加 `?dshlr=<时间戳>` 会强制 Node 产生新的模块实例，
   于是即使宿主没有 `--expose-internals`（`loadCache` 不可见）也能拿到新代码。代价是旧的模块实例会留在
   缓存里（开发期可接受）；工具输出会明确告诉你这一次用的是哪种方式（`mode: purge | bust | none`）。
   两种方式都拿不到新代码时不会假装成功：卡片上会打出显式警告。
3. **用宿主自己的 `entry.parent.tree.import(name, stack)` 重新加载**，而不是自己 `import()` 一个 URL：
   这条路径就是宿主 HMR 用的那条，`--expose-internals` 存在时走 `loader.internal.import`，不存在时退化为普通
   `import`，行为一致。
4. **import 失败绝不碰正在运行的插件**：先把新模块 import 成功，才动 registry；apply 抛错则把旧插件装回去
   （`rolledBack: true`）。
5. **为什么不用 `fs.watch`**：Windows 上编辑器普遍「写临时文件 → 改名覆盖」，`fs.watch` 经常漏事件；漏一次就等于
   改了代码不生效。插件源码目录很小（默认最多 5000 文件），700ms 扫一次指纹的开销可以忽略。
6. **webServer 用延迟注入、不写进 `inject` 数组**：headless profile 没有 webServer 服务，硬注入会让插件在
   headless 里起不来；`ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)` 既能等到服务就绪，又能在没有该服务的 profile 里继续跑 host 半边。
7. **浏览器半边手写而不是打包**：`lib/client.js` 就是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})` 的产物，
   零依赖、零构建；`dsh.client.immediately` 必须为 `true`，否则惰性模块表只「提供」不执行。

## 8. 自测

```powershell
node tests/selftest.mjs      # 29 例：忽略/指纹/差异、根发现、重载内核调用顺序、轮询、端点尾段、client half
node tests/integration.mjs   # 21 例：假宿主 apply → 工具 → 改动 → 重载 → 延迟注入路由 → 服务通知
```

integration 用的假宿主完整复刻了宿主的「无损 JSON 快照 + schema 严格校验 + render 必须返回
ContentBlock[] + presentResult 必须返回视图」，因此 schema 写错、字段漏声明都会被测出来。
`client half` 的用例会在 `node:vm` 里真的执行 `lib/client.js`，用假 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 与假 React
把按钮渲染出来（`data-dsh-live-reload="refresh"`）。

## 9. 排错

| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `live_reload status` 里 `roots` 是空的 | 没有 `link:` 装入的插件。用配置项 `watch` 手工指定目录，或 `exclude` 把它排除了 |
| 改了代码没重载 | `live_reload action=check` 手动催一次；或看 `ignore` 是否命中了你的文件；或该插件不在被监视目录里 |
| 报告「已热重载」但工具行为没变 | 先跑 `live_reload action=cache`：命中数为 0 说明缓存键没对上，会走 `mode=bust`；两者都没效果时重启一次 DSH 并反馈 `cache` 输出 |
| `reloaded[].mode = "none"` | 既没清掉缓存，也无法把模块名解析成文件（`dsh plugin add link:` 未装好或包名不对）；此时**没有**换代码 |
| `reloaded[].reason = "import-failed"` | 新代码有语法/导入错误，旧插件仍在运行（先修好语法） |
| `reloaded[].reason = "entry-not-loaded"` | 该插件当前没在运行（被禁用或未加载），自动路径会跳过 |
| 看不到刷新按钮 | 按钮挂在**会话标题栏右侧**——没打开会话时没有这个槽位；另外确认 `package.json` 里 `dsh.client.immediately === true`、页面是刷新后重新加载的（旧页面拿不到新的 client bundle） |
| 按钮点了没反应 | `/__dsh-live-reload/state` 是否 200（`curl -H` 带 token 或看浏览器网络面板）；`refreshUi: never` 时按钮仍然可点，但不会自动刷新 |
| 页面不自动刷新 | `refreshUi` 为 `auto` 时只在「没有输入框/可编辑区获得焦点」时自动刷新；`manual` 只点小圆点提示，需手动点按钮 |

## 10. 已验证

**host 半边**：在 headless profile（真实宿主进程，不是模拟宿主）里做过端到端验证：装入一个 `link:` 小白鼠插件
（`dsh-lr-victim`，模块级 `const VERSION`、每次求值生成随机 `LOAD_NONCE`）→ 它改写自己的源码 →
热重载 → 再次调用它的工具：拿到的是**新版本号 + 新的模块加载随机数**，而进程 PID 不变（没有重启）。

第 3 轮真机记录（`live_reload status` 与工具返回原文，节选自 `fixtures/lr-e2e-3.json`）：

```text
lr_victim_version → version=2 nonce=lbaet2tf loadedAt=2026-10-15T09:20:41.060Z pid=9072
lr_victim_bump    → 已写入 …\profiles\headless\node_modules\dsh-lr-victim\lib\index.js：2 → 3

live_reload status（自动监视触发后）
  ♻️ 热重载状态
  正在监视 3 个插件目录，已热重载 2 次。
  · dsh-lr-victim → D:/test-dsh/experiments/lr-victim
  ✅ dsh-lr-victim：清理 ESM 8 / CJS 0（清缓存后重新导入）
  · 变更 D:/test-dsh/experiments/lr-victim：lib/index.js
  统计：扫描 6 次 · 触发 2 次 · 重载 2 次 · 失败 0 次

lr_victim_version → version=3 nonce=csj16ukc loadedAt=2026-10-15T09:20:44.705Z pid=9072   ← 新代码生效

live_reload reload target=victim
  ♻️ 热重载 · reload
  ✅ dsh-lr-victim

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable permessage-deflate on the WebSocket transport (/api/remote.mux) without modifying the DSH install tree
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ws-deflate

**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Turns on `permessage-deflate` for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) web's WebSocket transport, **without modifying the DSH installation**. Measured on one machine: a session transcript that left the server as **1,206,822 B went out as 350,599 B — 70.9 % fewer wire bytes**.

It is a **runtime monkey-patch, not a supported extension point.** Read "Should I install this" before installing it.

## Should I install this?

**Install it if** you open `dsh web` from somewhere that is not your own machine — a Tailscale/VPN link, a reverse proxy over the internet, any path with real latency or packet loss. DSH replays the whole session transcript over `/api/remote.mux` on every reconnect, so on a lossy link those bytes are paid repeatedly.

**Do not install it if** you only ever use `dsh web` on `localhost` or a LAN. The saving is real but you don't need it there, and what you'd be taking on in exchange is a patch against another project's internals that can go quietly stale on every upgrade.

What it costs, measured on a Windows 10 / node v24 box: **+10 ms** to `dsh` startup (alternating 4-run measurement), and zlib level 6 at **42.7 ms per 1.53 MB** of transcript. The compression is per-message above a 1 KiB threshold, so small events are untouched.

## What it actually changes

Nothing on disk. `ws@8.22.0`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib` were compared file-by-file (sha256) against the pristine registry tarballs: **63 files, 0 mismatches, 0 extra, 0 missing**, and 0 files in the install tree written or created that day.

What it does change is one method, in memory, in the `dsh` process:

```
BEFORE  WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = handleUpgrade(req, socket, head, cb) {   ← ws's own
AFTER   WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = function (req, socket, head, cb) { try {  ← the wrapper
disk sha256 of ws/lib/websocket-server.js: 6d8dd89a841748c8 -> 6d8dd89a841748c8            ← unchanged
```

The wrapper sets `this.options.perMessageDeflate` at **handshake** time, which works because ws 8.x reads that option inside `handleUpgrade` (`websocket-server.js:299`/`:303`), not at construction — so it reaches the gateway's already-built `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` (`dsh-api-gateway/lib/index.js:179`). It only opts in when nothing else set the option, so **if DSH enables compression itself upstream, this plugin steps aside automatically.**

Why the option can't just be configured: DSH exposes no key for it. The webserver's `compression` is HTTP gzip and does not cover streams.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ws-deflate
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The bundle list is read at startup, so no restart means no effect.

## Verify

```bash
grep 'dsh-ws-deflate' <wherever your dsh web logs>
```

You want three things:

```
[dsh-ws-deflate] permessage-deflate enabled -> …/node_modules/ws [ws 8.22.0] via path (level 6, threshold 1024 B, noContextTakeover on)
[dsh-ws-deflate] self test OK: this process negotiates permessage-deflate
[dsh-ws-deflate] negotiated permessage-deflate with Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) …
```

The **self test** is the interesting one. DSH's browser auth rejects non-browser handshakes, so you cannot probe a live server from a script — the plugin instead builds its own `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` on an ephemeral loopback port and does a real handshake against it. That proves *this process, with this ws copy, negotiates*, which is the claim no external probe can reach. The `negotiated …` lines then log the first few real browser handshakes (user agent truncated, `maxLog` caps it at 5, `0` disables).

Browser side, if you want it: DevTools → Network → the `remote.mux` request → Response Headers should contain `Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate; …`.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ws-deflate
```

Restart. Nothing needs restoring, because nothing on disk was ever different.

## Configuration

Add or edit the entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: ws-deflate
  name: dsh-ws-deflate
  config:
    enabled: true
    level: 6
    thresholdBytes: 1024
    noContextTakeover: true
    concurrencyLimit: 10
    selfTest: true
    maxLog: 5
```

| key | default | notes |
|---|---:|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the wrapper installed but opts no handshake in |
| `level` | `6` | measured here: level 6 → ratio 0.176, level 1 → 0.238 on the same payload, at 42.7 ms vs 5.9 ms per 1.53 MB |
| `thresholdBytes` | `1024` | below this, frames go out raw (the median DSH event is ~800 B) |
| `noContextTakeover` | `true` | independent deflate stream per frame: bounded memory, and a dropped frame cannot corrupt later messages. Costs ratio, buys robustness on a lossy link — which is the whole reason to run this plugin |
| `concurrencyLimit` | `10` | cap on simultaneous compress operations |
| `selfTest` | `true` | run the loopback handshake at activation. Not hot-reloadable |
| `maxLog` | `5` | how many successful negotiations to log; `0` is silent |

Everything except `selfTest` is `.volatile()`, so editing the patch and letting the profile hot-reload re-applies it without a restart.

## How it finds the gateway's `ws` copy

A plugin cannot `import 'ws'` and get the gateway's copy. The profile is a pnpm tree that contains no `ws` at all; declaring it as a dependency installs a **second** copy — a different class object, and patching it does nothing. Three routes, tried in this order, all tested:

1. **Ask the process.** The gateway's `ws` is in the CommonJS module cache; the class found there is provably the one the gateway uses (`cached === path-required: true`). Match on `ws/lib/websocket-server.js`, **not** `ws/index.js` — ws routes `import` to `wrapper.mjs`, which goes straight at the lib file, so `index.js` never enters the cache in an ESM host. Note `lib/websocket-server.js` does `module.exports = WebSocketServer`, so the export *is* the class.
2. **Guess the path.** Honours `$DSH_HOME` (precedence: configured path > `$DSH_HOME` > `~/.dsh`) and checks `<home>/profiles/node_modules/ws`, which dsh itself creates as a junction into the install tree — the most portable entry. Plus npm-global prefixes for Windows (`%APPDATA%\npm`), Linux (`/usr/local`, `/usr/lib`) and both macOS locations (`/usr/local`, `/opt/homebrew`).
3. **Retry for ~2 s.** If neither finds anything, retry every 250 ms (unref'd, so it can never hold the process open). This is what covers an install whose prefix is not in the list: by the time the gateway has loaded, route 1 works. Tested by neutralising every candidate (`DSH_HOME` + `APPDATA` + `argv[1]` pointed at empty dirs), activating — nothing patched — then loading the gateway late: `located ws on deferred attempt 2 … via require.cache`, self test OK.

### One thing that will confuse you, on purpose

`import 'dsh-ws-deflate'` from a plain `node` script **fails** with `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'`, even though the plugin loads fine inside `dsh`. That is not a bug to fix: dsh runs its own interception resolver (`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1459` `scope === "installation"`, `:1479` `readPeerNames(...).has(name)`) and supplies declared peers from the installation tree. A fresh profile has no `schemastery` anywhere in it — verified on two platforms — and the plugin still activates. **So don't "verify" this plugin by importing it from a script; verify it by restarting `dsh web` and reading the log.**

## Tested on

| platform | node | dsh | ws | pnpm | result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windows 10 | v24.20.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 8.22.0 | 10.18.2 | live, 3 browser handshakes logged incl. macOS Safari |
| Linux | v22.19.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 8.22.0 | 12.11.2 | clean-room: fresh profile from the shipped template, installed from a packed tarball, booted on :3099, self test OK |

Both were installed from a local tarball, not from the registry. One combination per platform — treat anything else as untested. The structural guard is `typeof WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrad

plugins.description: DSH GitHub 热榜插件：按日/周/月给模型插件、Skill、MCP 服务等小工具排名，榜单类型可自定义。
plugins.readme_text:
# hotspot · DSH GitHub 热榜

给 DeepSeek Harness 装一块**自己的热榜**：按**日 / 周 / 月**追踪 GitHub 上的
模型插件、Skill、MCP 服务、桌宠挂件等小工具，看谁在涨、谁是新面孔、谁正在**飙升**，
并且**为每个项目生成中文简介**说明它是干什么的、解决什么问题。

安装后榜单以**独立可拖拽浮层**显示在页面上；**设置 → GitHub 热榜** 里也能看完整视图。
数据由宿主半侧抓取、采样、排名，浏览器半侧只负责画。

---

## 独立可拖拽浮层（v0.3.0 起）

榜单的主界面是一块**页面级悬浮面板**（挂在 DSH 的 `shell.overlay` 插槽，与桌宠同层，不占对话区）：

| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 拖标题栏 | 移动面板（鼠标 / 触摸 / 触控笔统一走 Pointer Events） |
| 拖右下角 | 调整面板大小（最小 300×220） |
| 点标题栏或「—」 | 折叠成一个可拖动的**小药丸**，点药丸再展开 |
| 点「✕」 | 隐藏（在 设置 → GitHub 热榜 里可恢复） |

- **位置、尺寸、模式都会记住**（localStorage 的 `hotspot-panel` 键），刷新页面或重启后回到原处。
- **永远不会丢**：位置与尺寸一律夹进视口，并保证至少 80px 留在屏幕内——窗口缩小、
  拔掉高分辨率显示器之后，面板也不会飘到看不见的地方。
- 浮层与设置页**共用同一个榜单组件**，不会出现两套渲染逻辑不一致。

### 视觉规范（v0.6.0 起）

界面**不写死任何颜色**，全部走 DSH 自己的设计 token `--dsw-*`，因此会自动长成"系统原生"的样子：

| 类别 | 用到的 token |
|---|---|
| 语义色 | `--dsw-alias-label-primary/-secondary/-tertiary/-quaternary`、`-link`、`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1`、`--dsw-alias-border-l2/l3`、`--dsw-alias-separator-primary`、`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`、`--dsw-alias-state-success/error/warn-*`、`--dsw-alias-button-primary-fill`、`--dsw-alias-label-primary-inverted` |
| 形状 | `--dsw-radius-md` / `--dsw-radius-panel`、`--dsw-elevation-panel` / `--dsw-elevation-soft` |
| 排版 | `--dsw-font`、`--dsw-font-base-16` |
| 交互 | `--dsw-focus-ring-color` / `--dsw-focus-ring-width`、`--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` |
| 滚动条 | `--dsw-alias-scrollbar-bg-l2` / `-hover-l2` |

每个变量都带**兜底值**（`var(--dsw-x, …)`）：token 被改名或缺失时界面仍然可用。
好处是——你自己装了皮肤、或者切到暗色主题，这块浮层会跟着变，而不会像以前那样是一块
与周围割裂的灰色板子。

**图标**优先用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 里的图标组件（经 `require` 取得，
与桌宠插件同一套做法）；取不到就退化成文本字形，绝不因为图标加载失败而崩。

**信息层级重做**：榜单改成可横向滚动的 tab 条、周期改成分段控件、新增一行
「区间 / 剔除 / 更新日程」状态、长说明折叠进「说明」按钮、列表顶部三名加重、
加载时用骨架屏、空状态区分「没数据 / 全被筛掉」、页脚合并成一行紧凑统计。

**无障碍**：`focus-visible` 焦点环、`aria-label` / `role`、尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
浮层默认 460×600、最小 320×240。

**三套视觉密度**（v0.7.0）：紧凑 / 舒适 / 宽松，在 **设置 → GitHub 热榜** 里切换，立刻生效
（通过 `hotspot-ui` 事件广播给浮层，不用重开）。实现上**只改本插件自己的 CSS 局部变量**
（`--hs-pad` / `--hs-gap` / `--hs-font` / `--hs-item-pad`），**不碰任何全局 `--dsw-*` token**——
两个插件都去改全局样式会互相打架。

> 全局换肤说明：DSH 提供了 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens(source, tokens)`，插件可以叠加一层
> token 覆盖来整体换肤。**本插件刻意不动全局样式**——两个插件都去改全局 token 会互相打架。
> 想要整体换肤请用专门的皮肤包（见下）；本插件只保证自己"长得像系统的一部分"。

---

## 更新日程（v0.4.0 起）

每个榜单**按自己的日程更新，其余时间冻结不变**——不是"一直在刷新"：

| 榜单 | 默认日程 |
|---|---|
| 日榜 | **每天 00:00**（每 24 小时） |
| 周榜 | **每周一 00:00**（= 周日 24:00） |
| 月榜 | **每月 1 号 00:00** |
| 飙升榜 | **每周一 00:00**，其余时间不动（它固定按周统计，日/周/月页签对它无效，界面上会置灰） |
| 总榜 | 每月 1 号 00:00 |
| 抓数据 | **每天 00:00 一次** |

三件事要分清：

1. **抓数据（采样）**：默认每天 0 点去 GitHub 抓一次，7 个查询榜共 **7 次请求/天**
   —— 相比 v0.3.0 的"每 5 分钟一轮"（约 2000 次/天）降了三个数量级，未认证额度绰绰有余。
2. **算榜单**：只有**有人看、且跨过了该榜单的更新边界**时才重算，算完**冻结**。
   没人在看的榜单不会白白消耗额度。
3. **区间**：一律是 [上一个更新边界, 本边界]，而且**两端都取采样**（as-of-boundary）。
   所以"本周涨星"就是上周一 0 点到本周一 0 点，"本月"就是上月 1 号到本月 1 号 ——
   标签即事实。（v0.4.0 拿"最新采样"当终点，会让月榜实际覆盖"上月 1 号到现在"，
   还会把首次运行时那段十几分钟的微弱历史冻结一整个月；v0.5.0 已修。）

界面上会显示每条榜的**下次更新时间与倒计时**，以及当前是不是冻结结果。

- **采样历史还不够跨满一个周期时**，不会退回"按总星数"，而是用现有最早的采样算涨星、
  并**如实标注实际区间**（例如"区间 9 小时（实际短于一个完整周期）"）——比退化成总星数有信息量。
- **手动点"刷新"**会绕过冻结，并**强制重新抓一次数据**（这是显式的人工干预）。
- 日程全部可配（见下面的配置示例）：`every` 支持 `day` / `week` / `month`；
  `weekday` 用 0=周日 … 6=周六；`month.day` 超出当月天数时按当月最后一天算（31 号在 2 月 = 2/28）。

---

## 榜单质量：模型相关性判定 + 综合打分（v0.5.0 起）

光按话题抓 GitHub 是**不够**的。实测把原始榜单跑出来之后，问题很明显：

| 榜单 | 条目 | ★>5万 的项目 | 中位星数 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dsh-plugin` | 50 | **5**（rea ★254k、deepseek-harness ★250k…） | 7,625 |
| `agent-skills` | 50 | **17** | 32,500 |
| `dsh-skin` | 26 | 0 | **1** |

平台级框架、awesome-list 合集会靠话题匹配大量混进来，把「小工具」挤下去。
所以 v0.5.0 加了一层**用模型做的策展**：

1. **零成本规则预筛**（不花模型调用）
   - 名字/简介命中合集关键词（`awesome` / `curated` / `导航` / `合集` …）→ 直接剔除
   - ★ ≥ `ranking.platformStars`（默认 10 万）→ 直接判为平台级
2. **模型逐条判定**：让它回答「这是本榜该收的**具体小工具**吗」，输出
   `{"verdict":"tool|platform|list|unrelated","relevance":0-100,"reason":"…"}`
3. **过滤**：`requireTool` 时只留 `tool`；`relevance < minRelevance`（默认 50）剔除
4. **综合打分**：`区间涨星 + relevance × relevanceWeight(0.05) + 新鲜度(0/1/2)`
   —— 相关性只是**边际修正**，不会盖过真实涨星，否则小榜单会被一堆"高相关但零增长"的项目占满。

几个设计细节：

- **判定按榜隔离**：同一仓库在 `mcp-server` 榜可能是工具、在 `dsh-skin` 榜就是无关，
  所以缓存键是「榜 + 仓库 + 内容指纹」。
- **主动预热**（v0.7.0，v0.7.1 修正）：把各榜候选的前 `classifyPrewarm`（默认 50）条排进判定队列。
  注意预热**不绑定在采样上**——否则白天重启（当天采样早已完成）就再也不会预热，
  表现成「重启一次 = 判定从零开始」。现在每轮检查都会补，已判定的自动跳过。
  早期版本还要求「有人看才判」，
  而不是"等有人看才判"。否则用户打开面板那几分钟里，榜上仍是未判定的巨型项目，
  恰好把"用模型优化榜单"的观感拖没了。
- **异步、可缓存**：后台串行判定，每轮最多 `classifyBatch` 条；
  判定结果**永久缓存**（官方简介/话题变了才重新判定）。
- **待判定的排在已判定之后**，并标「判定中」；此时结果是**临时**的（不冻结），
  判定完成后会自动重算并锁定。
- **关得掉**：`"classify": false` 时只做规则预筛。
- 成本：每个「仓库 × 榜单」一次极短调用（约 100 token 量级），结果长期复用。
  默认 `platformStars` 会挡掉最贵的那几个巨型项目，不必为它们花调用。

## 三个核心机制

### 1. 中文简介：官方简介往往不够用

GitHub 上的 description 多半是英文、且短到看不出「它到底解决什么问题」。
hotspot 用 **DSH 自己的模型**（`ctx.llm`，与你在对话里用的是同一套适配器与凭据）
为每个上榜项目生成 1–2 句中文简介：**它是什么 + 能解决什么问题**。

- **异步生成、落盘缓存**：`/rank` 先返回已经有的简介，缺的在后台排队生成，
  界面每 60 秒轮询一次，所以你会看到「简介生成中…」逐步变成中文简介，而不是干等。
- **按内容失效**：缓存里记着生成时的「官方简介 + 话题 + 语言」指纹，这些变了才重新生成。
- **失败有冷却**（默认 6 小时），不会反复拿同一个失败项目去撞模型。
- **可以关**：配置里 `"summarize": false`，或换用指定模型 `"summaryModel": {"provider": "...", "model": "..."}`
  （默认跟随当前对话的模型）。
- **降级**：模型服务不可用时，只有简介这一项消失（界面显示原文 + 标记），其余功能照常。
- **不依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 能被 import**：实测该包在本地 `node_modules` 里
  **没有 package.json**、且是指向 npx 缓存的链接，裸 `import` 与绝对路径 `import` 都会失败。
  所以本插件**自带一份协议正确的实现**（消息带 `id`、认 `text-delta` 分片、读 `finish`），
  官方包只在能加载到时优先使用。
- **失败记录带插件版本**：升级后旧失败会被视为「可能已被修掉的 bug」而自动重试，
  不必等冷却过去（`POST /dsh-hotspot/summaries/reset` 也可手动清空）。

> ⚠️ 简介会**消耗你的模型额度**（每条一次很短的小请求，约 100 token 量级），且结果永久缓存。
> 不想要就把 `summarize` 设为 `false`。

### 2. 采样：一切「涨了多少」的前提

GitHub API **不提供历史星数**。`GET /search/repositories` 只给「此刻」的
`stargazers_count`，没有任何接口能告诉你某个仓库上周有多少星。所以任何日榜/周榜/月榜/飙升榜都只能是：

```
区间涨星 = 当前星数 − 区间起点星数
```

区间起点必须由插件自己存。hotspot 每次抓取都往当天的快照文件追加一个**带时间戳的样本**
（同一天内多次抓取 = 多个样本）：

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/hotspot/snapshots/2026-10-15.json
{ "date": "2026-10-15", "samples": [
  { "at": "2026-10-15T02:00:00.000Z", "stars": { "owner/repo": 1234 } },
  { "at": "2026-10-15T02:15:00.000Z", "stars": { "owner/repo": 1241 } }
] }
```

日内多采样的两个好处：区间基线能精确到「不晚于 cut-off 的最近一个样本」；
飙升榜可以算**每天涨多少星**的速度，而不是只能拿整天当最小粒度。

> ⚠️ 合并采样时**只更新星数、绝不推进 `at`**（并用 `lastAt` 记录星数的实际观测时刻）。
> 这一点是 v0.2.1 修的 bug：0.2.0 合并时把 `at` 推到当前时刻，导致一天下来永远只剩一个
> 「当前时刻」的采样，时间序列被自己抹掉 —— 飙升榜永远 `insufficient-history`，
> 区间涨星也永远算不出来。
（0.1.0 的旧格式 `{ date, savedAt, stars }` 仍能正确读取。）

于是存在一个**诚实的冷启动期**：

| 样本情况 | 排名依据 | 界面标识 |
|---|---|---|
| 只有 1 个样本 | 按**总星数**排 | `按总星数` |
| ≥ 2 个不同时刻的样本 | 按**区间涨星**排，附 `新上榜` 标记 | `按区间涨星` |
| 飙升榜样本不足 | 不编数据，明说还要等 | `样本积累中` |

这不是缺陷，是这类工具的物理限制 —— 与其假装能算，不如把依据摊开给你看。
抓数据的节奏见下文「更新日程」：默认**每天 0 点抓一次**，所以第二天起才会有区间涨星与飙升数据
（第一天只有一份采样，只能按总星数排；这是数据本身的限制，不是开关没生效）。

### 3. 飙升榜：跨榜单的全局速度榜

普通榜单是「某条 GitHub 查询里总星数靠前的 N 个仓库」，按各自基线算涨星。
**飙升榜不看任何查询**，而是在**全部被追踪过的仓库**（`repos.json` 注册表）里，
按窗口内的涨星量排序，并给出「星/天」速度 —— 所以它能捞到各个榜单之外的黑马。

- 飙升榜**固定按自己的日程**统计（默认每周一 0 点更新），页签对它不起作用（界面上会置灰）。
- 区间 = [上一个更新边界, 本边界]。「本月」天然等于上一个 1 号到本月 1 号，28/30/31 天都不用特判。
- 只统计**基线采样里已存在**的仓库。新出现的仓库不计入速度（否则「刚建的新库」会被误报成飙升）。

---

## 已知边界

- **抓的是「总星数靠前的一批仓库」，不是「涨星最快的一批」**。
  每榜每轮只取一次搜索结果（默认 50 条）。总星数很低但近期暴涨的黑马，
  可能还没进这 50 条 —— 除非它已经被收录进注册表（那样飙升榜能看到它）。
- **未认证的 GitHub 搜索接口只有 10 次/分钟**（实测；认证后 30 次/分钟）。
  但 v0.4.0 起改成按日程抓：默认**每天 7 次请求**，远低于 10 次/分钟，
  所以**不配 token 也完全够用**（除非你把 `sample` 改成高频心跳）。
- **限流不会清空你的榜**：403/429 会保留上一次成功的数据、标记 `stale`，
  并把 GitHub 给的重置时间透传到界面。

---

## 安装

### 官方桌面客户端（Electron）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add '<hotspot 所在目录的绝对路径>'
```

装完**从系统托盘完全退出** DeepSeek Harness 再启动。

### CLI Web 版

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add '<hotspot 所在目录的绝对路径>'
```

> 路径要用**绝对路径**且指向含 `package.json` 的那一层，别多套一层同名目录。

---

## 配 token（强烈建议）

**v0.4.0 起基本不需要 token**：默认每天只抓 7 次请求，未认证额度绰绰有余。
只有当你把 `schedule.sample` 改成高频、或把 `refreshMinutes` 设成心跳时才有必要。

1. **环境变量**（推荐）：设 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 或 `GH_TOKEN`，然后重启 DSH。
   细粒度 token 只要 **Public Repositories (read-only)** 权限即可。
2. **配置文件**：`$DSH_HOME/hotspot/config.json` 里写 `"token": "ghp_xxx"`。

界面上会显示 token 是否生效。

---

## 配置

`$DSH_HOME/hotspot/config.json`（首次运行自动生成默认值；也可 `PUT /dsh-hotspot/config` 写）：

```jsonc
{
  "cacheMinutes": 2,          // 结果内存缓存；调小 = 更及时，代价是更多 GitHub 请求
  "refreshMinutes": 0,        // 额外心跳抓取（分钟

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect.
