plugins.readme_text:
# 会话标题命名 · Title Oil

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 自动整理会话名称，采用 [oil-codex-title](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-codex-title) 的 **「类别 emoji + 对象｜目标」** 风格，方便在侧边栏区分正在做的事情。

**版本 0.5.0** · **MIT** · 已在 **macOS / DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2** 验证。

这是独立插件，可以单独安装；[会话花费与余额](https://github.com/ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-session-cost) 是另一个可选插件。

## 命名效果

以下为格式示例，实际结果由所选模型生成：

| 会话内容 | 示例标题 |
| --- | --- |
| 排查支付回调重复发货 | 🧩 支付回调｜重复发货修复 |
| 为图像模型评测策划视频 | 🎬 图像模型评测｜视频策划 |
| 调整登录表单的布局 | 🎨 登录表单｜布局优化 |
| 比较数据库方案 | 🔎 数据库｜方案比较 |

- **持续更新**：每条用户消息后，宿主在后台重新评估标题，不打断正文回复。
- **参考实际工作**：读取最近的用户消息，以及上一轮 assistant 回复摘要与工具名称。
- **保持稳定**：当前标题仍准确时保持原样；默认跳过「嗯、好、继续」等纯确认消息。
- **手动命名优先**：在 DSH 中手动改名后，由宿主固定标题，自动命名不再覆盖。
- **规则可配置**：模型、参考消息数、中英文长度和类别都可在应用内调整，保存后生效。

## 安装

### 桌面版：从插件管理器安装（推荐）

1. 打开 DSH 左侧的 **插件 → 添加插件**。
2. 在安装目标中粘贴：

   ```text
   github:ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-title-oil#v0.5.0
   ```

3. 点击安装，完成后选择 **立即启用**。
4. 若管理器提示需要重启，完全退出并重新打开 DSH。打开 **插件 → 会话标题命名** 检查设置页。

源码已是可运行的 JavaScript，**没有构建步骤或安装脚本**。当前通过 GitHub 分发，尚未发布到 npm；无需手写 profile 配置。

DSH 同时只能使用一个自动标题提供者。此插件的 bundle 会关闭内置的 `session-title-llm` 并注册自身；已有其他自动命名插件时，请先在管理器中停用冲突项。

### 使用 `dsh web` 的用户

只对独立的 `web` profile 使用以下命令；桌面版优先使用插件管理器：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-title-oil#v0.5.0
```

安装后重启已有的 `dsh web` 进程并刷新页面。不同 profile 独立安装；这里的 CLI 语法已对照官方实现，Web 版没有完成与桌面版同等的运行验证。

### 从本地源码安装

```sh
git clone --branch v0.5.0 https://github.com/ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-title-oil.git
cd dsh-plugin-title-oil
pwd
```

将 `pwd` 输出的绝对目录填入 **插件 → 添加插件**。宿主提供 DSH 依赖，不需要另外构建。保留该目录，因为本地目录安装可能链接到源码。

## 开始使用

1. 打开 **插件 → 会话标题命名**，或 **设置 → 标题命名**。
2. 选择用于命名的供应商和模型。默认路由为 `deepseek-account / deepseek-flash`；如果当前宿主没有此模型，从下拉列表改选可用模型，或选择「跟随会话路由」。
3. 调整标题规则与分类，点击 **保存修改**。
4. 新建会话并发送有明确内容的消息，观察侧边栏标题更新。
5. 想保留某个标题时，直接在 DSH 中手动重命名会话。

**自动命名会产生独立的模型调用。** 收费、套餐额度与共享规则由所选供应商决定；跟随会话路由也不代表免计费。命名上下文会发送给所选供应商，包含最近消息、assistant 摘要及工具名称。费用插件的主会话估算不包含这类辅助调用。

## 设置项

| 设置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 命名供应商 / 模型 | `deepseek-account / deepseek-flash` | 可选择已配置路由，或两项一起留空以跟随会话 |
| 参考消息 | 5 条 | 最近的用户消息数，范围 1–20 |
| 中文长度 | 6 字 | 「对象」「目标」每段的期望上限，范围 1–30 |
| 英文长度 | 4 词 | 每段的期望词数，范围 1–20 |
| 跳过纯确认消息 | 开启 | 「嗯、好、继续」等不触发改名 |
| 分类规则 | 5 类 | emoji、名称与描述；删除所有行并保存后恢复内置类别 |
| 输入上限（高级） | 8192 字节 | UTF-8 上下文预算，范围 1024–65536 |
| 输出上限（高级） | 64 tokens | 命名模型最大输出，范围 1–256 |
| 超时（高级） | 30 秒 | 范围 1–120 秒；长输入会优先保留最新意图 |

长度是提示词目标，模型不保证逐字满足。内置类别为 🎬 内容制作、🧩 工具开发、🔎 对比调研、🎨 页面设计、📝 方法整理。

保存失败时保留草稿；并发冲突时可使用「重新载入并替换草稿」读取最新设置。**恢复默认**会清除用户覆盖，回到 bundle 的默认配置，不需要重启。

## 数据与兼容范围

配置默认保存在 `~/.dsh/plugin-data/title-oil/config.overrides.json`。设置了 `DSH_HOME` 时使用其下的 `plugin-data/title-oil/`。目录 0700、配置 0600，采用原子写入。

首次加载会复制旧源码目录中的覆盖配置并保留原件。配置不包含独立保存的模型 API key；模型调用使用 DSH 中已有的供应商配置。

当前验证基线是 macOS / DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2。其他操作系统、宿主版本及模型服务尚未全面验证。插件只有 Web/桌面设置界面，不承诺 TUI 可用。

## 更新与卸载

- **更新**：备份上述数据目录，按插件管理器提示更换到新版本 tag；若要求先卸载再安装，配置目录会保留。
- **停用或卸载**：在插件管理器关闭开关或选择卸载。移除本 bundle 后，内置标题提供者应随其覆盖层解除而恢复；若还有其他配置覆盖，检查标题提供者启用状态。
- **Web CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-title-oil`，然后重启对应进程。
- 卸载不会删除用户配置，也不会批量改动已有会话标题。

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 标题没变化 | 检查是否手动命名、最新消息是否为纯确认；确认插件启用及命名模型可用 |
| 模型下拉加载失败 | 先确认 DSH 中相同供应商能正常使用；保存的模型会保留，可稍后重试 |
| 提示标题提供者冲突 | 停用其他命名插件，确认只保留一个提供者 |
| 标题更新慢 | 选择响应更快的模型，减少参考消息数或输入预算；模型服务的网络延迟仍有影响 |
| 浏览器直接打开兼容设置 URL 返回 401 | API 使用 DSH 的认证上下文，请从应用内打开设置 |
| 保存提示冲突 | 记录需要保留的修改，重新载入最新配置后再次保存 |

## 开发与验证

开发测试使用 Node.js 22，无需额外安装依赖即可运行策略测试：

```sh
npm test
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

测试覆盖语义目标反转、长中文和 emoji 的 UTF-8 预算，不产生模型调用。Host 运行需要由 DSH 提供 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title`；普通 Node 导入不能代替宿主验证。

已检查真实 DSH 加载、设置页和保存行为；发布检查没有触发付费命名调用，因此不声称覆盖所有模型的实际命名质量。更多细节见 [实现与接口](docs/architecture.md)。

## 许可与致谢

[MIT](LICENSE)。命名规则参考并改编自 [oil-codex-title](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-codex-title)，运行能力由 DeepSeek Harness 提供。版权与许可保留在 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。本项目并非 DeepSeek 或 oil-codex-title 的官方插件。

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: DSH guard against self-repetition in streamed model output: detects a degeneration loop in reasoning or visible text, aborts the runaway turn and wakes the agent with a corrective notice.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-output-loop-guard

An **output self-repetition watchdog** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/).
When a model starts cycling the same short block instead of producing a tool call, the guard
aborts that generation and wakes the agent with a corrective notice — no human stop button,
and no human typing "continue".

- Bundle for DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`, ESM, zero runtime dependencies.
- 21 self-contained regression checks (`npm test`).
- Calibrated against 27 real sessions / 1,783 assistant steps: **24 detections, 0 false positives**.

## The gap it fills

DSH ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder`, which only sees **duplicate tool calls**
(same tool, same arguments, 3/5/8 times in a row). A degeneration loop in the *reasoning
channel* is invisible to it. In the session that motivated this plugin:

- the model repeated `好。→（执行）→好。→Write.→…` in its reasoning for **112,109 characters**,
  emitted in **50,196 stream chunks over 126 seconds of continuous decoding**, and produced
  **zero tool calls** — so `repeat-tool-reminder` could not fire;
- automatic compaction never ran either: its trigger is
  `floor(min(W × 0.8, W − O − B))` ≈ 678k tokens for a 1M window with a 256k output cap,
  while the session peaked around 508k tokens;
- the loop only ended when the human pressed stop, and the polluted text stayed in the
  transcript, which made further loops more likely (self-imitation).

`output-loop-guard` listens on the live `agent/assistant-stream` frames and looks at the text itself.

## How it works

A sliding window over streamed output (1,200 characters by default, inspected every 64 new
characters) feeds four signals:

| Signal | Rule | Catches |
|---|---|---|
| `repeated-block` | **Shortest-period** block (≥2 newlines, ≥2 distinct non-whitespace chars) repeated ≥6 times | Multi-line cycles, e.g. the 106-character `好。→（执行）→Write.` cycle |
| `dominant-gram` | One n-gram covers ≥55% of the window with ≥24 occurrences and spans ≥2 lines | Loops whose tail is ragged but where repetition already dominates |
| `repeated-line` | Single-line runs: ≥40 in the reasoning channel, ≥60 in visible text (`singleLineTextMinRepeats`, `0` disables) | Reasoning spinning on one line, runaway line duplication in answers |
| `flat-tic` | Whitespace-free short gram covering ≥25% of the window with ≥48 occurrences, **reasoning only** | Line-less tics (`好。好。好。…`) |

Two design rules keep it precise:

- **Only the shortest period counts.** When one line repeats, 2× and 3× the line length are also
  "periods"; judging on an arbitrary period turned an ordinary bullet list into a "multi-line
  cycle" during calibration. The guard therefore looks only at the shortest period and requires
  that block itself to span ≥2 newlines.
- **Channel awareness.** Repeated lines in visible output are usually legitimate content
  (generated fixtures, config files, lists), so the visible-text single-line threshold is higher
  (60) than the reasoning one (40), and line-less tics are only judged in the reasoning channel.
  Indentation runs, `====` / `----` rule lines and blank-line runs never trip the guard.

On detection the guard:

1. calls `agent.cancel({ kind: 'hook', reason: 'output-loop-guard: …' })` — the in-flight
   generation is aborted and recorded as interrupted, so the degenerate text stops growing;
2. calls `agent.steer(<notice>)` — because the signal is already aborted, `steer` upgrades to a
   **fresh turn** and wakes the driver, so the agent immediately continues with an explicit
   correction (stop restating, emit the next action or finish);
3. after `maxTripsPerTurn` trips in one turn it stops auto-continuing and only `inject`s the
   notice, so a genuinely broken model cannot spin forever.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: the loader reads `dsh.bundle.patch` from `package.json`
(`dsh.plugin.json` is optional metadata used by some local plugin indexes — the official runtime
ignores it), and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `output-loop-guard` row.

```sh
# A. from a git host, pinned to a commit (requires `git` on the PATH of the DSH process)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "github:ADistanceThereIs/dsh-output-loop-guard#<commit>"

# B. from the release tarball — no git required
#    download dsh-output-loop-guard-0.1.0.tgz from the Releases page, then:
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-output-loop-guard-0.1.0.tgz

# C. straight from the release asset URL (needs Node to trust your system CA store)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add \
  https://github.com/ADistanceThereIs/dsh-output-loop-guard/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-output-loop-guard-0.1.0.tgz
```

All three append the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and compose the bundle's patch layer.
**Restart DSH for the row to activate.**

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-output-loop-guard
```

## Configuration

Override the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the row's whole `config`,
so restate every key you want to keep):

```yaml
- id: output-loop-guard
  name: dsh-output-loop-guard
  config:
    dryRun: false                 # true = detect and log only, never cancel
    autoContinue: true            # wake the agent with the corrective notice
    maxTripsPerTurn: 2            # auto-continue budget per turn
    windowChars: 1200
    checkEveryChars: 64
    minPeriodRepeats: 6           # repeats required for a multi-line cycle
    singleLineMinRepeats: 40      # reasoning-channel single-line threshold
    singleLineTextMinRepeats: 60  # visible-text single-line threshold (0 = off)
    useDominantGram: true
    dominantGramCoverage: 0.55
    dominantGramMinCount: 24
    useFlatTic: true
    ticMinCount: 48
    ticMinCoverage: 0.25
    verbose: false
```

Start with `dryRun: true` if you want to observe detections in your own sessions before letting
the guard abort anything.

## Evidence

### Corpus calibration

Replayed over 27 real sessions / 1,783 assistant steps (a corpus containing both healthy and
degenerate real output):

- 24 detections, **0 false positives**;
- every loop step of the motivating session was caught, plus a same-pattern loop in an unrelated
  session;
- detection latency: the 112,109-character runaway was caught after **2,944 characters (2.6 %)**;
  other loops were caught within 1,152–7,808 characters — hundreds of milliseconds instead of
  20–126 seconds of spinning.

### Runtime verification

End-to-end check in a live DSH runtime, on a task engineered to repeat two lines 300 times. The
session log of that run contains:

```json
{"type":"turn/end","data":{"turn":1,"reason":{"kind":"aborted","reason":{"kind":"hook","reason":"output-loop-guard: repeated output (repeated-block)"}}}}
{"type":"assistant/message","interrupted":true}          // cut off after 9 repetitions, not 300
{"type":"user/message","source":{"kind":"output-loop-guard","form":"notice"}}
```

The agent then delivered the same content as a **file** instead of continuing to repeat it, which
is exactly the intended outcome: the guard stops runaway output, it does not kill the task.

### Regression suite

`npm test` runs 21 self-contained checks (no corpus needed): the real degeneracy must be aborted
(24,180-character stream caught after 576 characters), healthy long documents must be untouched,
realistic written output (lists, code blocks, tables, rule lines, fixtures) must not trip,
runaway written lines must trip, `dryRun` must not cancel, a disabled plugin must attach nothing,
and a throwing agent handle must not break the stream.

## Limitations

- Visible-text single-line repetition needs ≥60 identical consecutive lines (that protects
  legitimate fixtures and lists); disable with `singleLineTextMinRepeats: 0`.
- Detection is structural (periodicity and density), not semantic: a modified near-repeat may
  escape `repeated-block`, though `dominant-gram` / `flat-tic` usually covers it.
- Trips are counted per agent and per attempt; subagents do not share counters.
- A trip discards the tool call that step had not emitted yet — one retry is the price for not
  spinning for minutes. Use `dryRun` to observe first.

#

plugins.description: 三贤人 Tri-Sages — 三份互不可见的自我各自判断：必须选边、无弃权；赞成须写出「什么观测会推翻我」，否则记为反对；重大事项三票一致，僵局只有最年长者能签字降档。Three blind selves judge independently: no abstention, approval must state its own refutation, dissents archived verbatim. DSH plugin, 54 tests.
plugins.readme_text:
# 三贤人 · tri-Sages

[![CI](https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-tri-Sages/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-tri-Sages/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen) [![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v0.2.1-blue)](https://github.com/youran0faust/dsh-tri-Sages/releases/tag/v0.2.1)

> **同一件事问两遍，它给你两个答案——而且不会告诉你。**

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的多智能体判决插件。三台人格单元各自独立判断、互不可见、**必须选边**；投赞成必须写出「什么观测会推翻我」；再按规则计票，并把每一票的理由与少数派的异议**逐字留痕**。

> 中文 | [English](README.en.md) · MIT · 零运行时依赖

## 它回答什么问题

让大模型帮你做决定，有三种结构性失败，而且都发生在**不可逆**的场合：

| 失败 | 长什么样 |
|---|---|
| **和稀泥** | 一份滴水不漏的两面话。读完你还在原地——信息增加了，决定没有 |
| **许愿机** | 顺着提问者的偏好给结论。你听到的是自己想听的 |
| **无法自证** | 同一个问题问两遍可能得到两个答案，而它不会告诉你「我这次不一样了」 |

三贤人把纪律写进**机制**，而不是写进提示词的好意：

| 痛点 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| 和稀泥：读完仍站在原地 | **必须选边**——判决只有赞成／反对，**没有弃权**；落在判断域之外也要给判断，把把握写进保留意见 |
| 许愿机：给提问者想听的答案 | **赞成负举证责任**——投赞成必须写出「什么观测会推翻我」；写不出，这一票由系统**记为反对** |
| 单模型判断无法自证 | **三票一致 ＋ 引擎自证**——重大事项任一反对即否决；每条记录带引擎版本与人格哈希 |
| 结论不可复核 | **异议逐字存档**——少数派的理由原样落盘，不进摘要、不可覆盖 |
| 僵局卡死，无人负责 | **降档要签字**——只有最年长的那一台能被再问一次，由她签字改成多数决；权力转移必须留名 |
| 人格是黑盒，改不动 | **人格与契约是外部 Markdown**——每次表决现读，改完下一次即生效，无需重启 |

### 三台是什么

| 单元 | 她是哪一份自我 | 她只问一个问题 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 少女 · 黄金 | 还没做过 | 这件事**可能**成立吗 |
| 成女 · 乳香 | 正在做 | 这件事**办得成**吗，代价谁付 |
| 熟女 · 没药 | 已经做过太多 | **三十年后**还剩什么 |

三样礼物里只有黄金是给活人的——所以**替「现在还活着的人」说话的那一台，天生是少数派**。

每台还带一条**自查**，能把她自己刚写下的赞成翻成反对。熟女那条：*「把时间尺度缩到一代人之内，这个判断还成立吗？」*

## 安装

前置：DSH（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`）`0.2.0-rc.2`（清单里以 `peerDependencies` 声明）+ Node.js ≥ 20。

### 方式 A：本地挂载（推荐）

把本目录放进 profile，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tri-sages
      name: ./tri-sages/index.mjs
      config:
        llmMode: live
```

### 方式 B：装成包

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <名> add <本目录路径>
```

装好后两种入口：

| 输入 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/sages 要不要把旧表删掉` | 跑一次表决（档位自动判断，命中敏感词自动升到重大） |
| `/sages critical 要不要现在就动手` | 强制按重大判：三票一致才过，任一反对即否决 |
| `/sages normal 中午吃什么` | 强制按日常判：多数决 |
| `/sages history` | 翻账本（最近 10 次） |
| `/sages ts-000001` | 取回某一次完整记录（含三台原话） |
| `/sages personas` | 看当前生效的三份人格 |
| `/sages help` | 用法 |

> 若 `/` 菜单里没列出它，**手打完整字符串**即可（和 `/permission`、`/cache-report` 一样，命令是注册好的）。

模型侧直接调工具：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `sages_vote(question, context?, criticality?, label?)` | 发起表决。返回票数、判决、三份原话与账本 id |
| `sages_history(limit?, key?)` | 翻账本；`key` 可按 id（`ts-000003`）或 label 取回某一次 |
| `sages_personas(action?, unit?)` | 看当前生效的人格（sha256／字数）；`action:"text"` 取全文 |

判决只有三种：`APPROVED` / `REJECTED` / `VETO`。三台全都没回话时是 `ERROR`——**不伪造判决**。

> ⚠️ **代码改动要重启；人格与契约改完即生效。** 加载器的热重载只重跑 `apply`，不热换 ESM 模块。所以每条账本记录都带 `pluginVersion`、每份报告都打印 `引擎：tri-sages vX.Y.Z`——用来确认**跑起来的到底是哪一版**。

## 示例输出

> 以下取自**真实账本**（`ts-000001`，中文原文；本仓库已对私人称呼与绝对路径脱敏）。
> 这一条早于引擎版本自证（v0.2.0 起才有），所以没有 `引擎：` 那一行。

```
$ /sages critical 从今以后，AI 助手在做不可逆的大改动之前（删文件、改 profile 配置、
                  装卸插件、批量改写），是否必须先跑一次三贤人表决？

三贤人 · ts-000001 · 2026-10-16 15:07:45
档位：重大（命中敏感词：不可逆）
结果：否決 VETO · 0:3（未获一致）

① 少女 · 黄金   反对   conf 0.72
     理由：这条路我没见过走通。不可逆没有清单，谁能触发没写，卡住超时怎么办没写，
           靠自觉的规矩会滑成两种：天天跑，或没人跑。否决权是单向的——一台模型的
           犹豫就能停一次回滚；三台又是同一套模型，错会一起错，三份判断换不来三份证据。
     可推翻：出现已定义的不可逆清单、超时默认放行机制，并有真实拦下一次误操作的记录，我就改判。
     保留：我愿意相信流程能约束人，这是希望不是证据，按自查改为反对。
② 成女 · 乳香   反对   conf 0.68
     理由：闸门的触发条件由被判断者自己认定……真正挡住不可逆损害的是备份、回收站、
           回退路径，这些机器查得到，模型的自评查不到。
     保留：把触发条件换成外部固定清单（无备份的删除、凭据与 profile 写入、装卸插件），
           并强制动手前写下回退路径与备份点，我改判赞成。
③ 熟女 · 没药   反对   conf 0.63
     理由：判断者与被判断者同源，这一票给不出新信息，只给出一份可以引用的合法性。
           「写不出推翻条件就反对」这条纪律值得留，它不必以表决为形。

降档：最年长的那一台拒签 → 否决维持
     她的原话：0 比 3 不是僵局，是一致。我签字改的是规则本身：今天为「让它走完」
               降一次档，明天任何被否决的事都能再拿来问我一遍。那道闸门回不去。
模型：deepseek-v4.1-flash（会话默认）
用时：49.8s
```

**这套系统第一次表决，否掉的是它自己。** 而且三台的理由互不相同：少女说「这条路没人走通」，成女说「真正拦得住的是备份，不是再想一遍」，熟女说「同源判断不产生新信息，只产生引用凭据」。

## 怎么读它的判决

**票数不是概率，一致不是正确。** 最容易读错的地方：

| 陷阱 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **单次读数不是结论** | 逐字相同的输入曾给出不同票面（同题两跑：一次 2:1、一次 3:0）。把一次结果当判断用之前，先复跑 |
| **3:0 不等于「必然对」** | 它只等于「三份自我在这三条轴上没有分歧」。三条轴都偏保守，所以一致通过也可能是**集体盲区** |
| **confidence 不是把握度** | 那是那一台自己报的数，没有校准过；同一台在同一题上会在 0.56–0.86 之间漂 |
| **看报告顶部的 ⚠** | 有台没回话时，它那一票是**系统代投**的反对，不是它的判断（账本保留该台的原始返回） |
| **降档要看谁签的字** | 僵局被改成多数决，是**最年长那一台**签的；她的理由往往比判决本身更值得读 |

### 三条实用规则

1. **看异议，不看票数。** 一致通过说明不了什么；**少数派的理由**才是这套系统真正产出的东西。
2. **只有重大事项才用 `critical`。** 它要求三票一致、任一反对即否决；日常事用它只会得到一堆 `VETO`。
3. **读 caveats。** 那里装着每一台自己都不太信的部分——`保留` 字段通常比 `理由` 更接近真相。

## 数据来源与隐私

**表决时发出去什么**：三台各自的 system prompt（人格 ＋ 公共契约）＋ 同一份「议题 ＋ 背景」。**没有会话历史、没有工具定义、没有文件内容**——`ctx.llm.stream` 是一次性调用。

**三台没有手**：它们不能读写文件、不能执行命令、不能调用任何工具。它们只能说话。

**账本**：本机 JSONL，`<DSH_HOME>/tri-sages/ledger.jsonl`，**追加写、不覆盖**。含议题、三台原话、异议、人格与契约的 sha256、引擎版本。

**不发**：不上传账本、不连第三方服务、不读你的会话日志。除了那次模型调用，它不联网。

> ⚠️ **议题会进入模型调用**——别把密钥、凭据原文写进议题里。

## 工程结构

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `index.mjs` / `command.mjs` | 插件入口（三个工具）与斜杠命令入口 |
| `lib/` | 计票、人格装载、提示词组装、模型桥、输出解析、账本、呈现、离线桩、模块解析 |
| `personas/` | 三份人格 ＋ 公共输出契约（外部 Markdown，每次表决现读） |
| `test/` | 54 项测试，含用宿主真实工具定义机制的挂载测试 |
| `tools/` | 补丁校验、模型探测 |
| `refs/` | 实验材料：答案集、实测报告、脱敏账本 |

## 局限（诚实说明）

- **三台共用同一套权重。** 「独立」是**人格层面**的独立，不是参数层面的。这是本项目最重要的局限，也是下一步要解决的事（为三份自我各训练一个适配器）。
- **单次读数不是结论。** 逐字相同的输入曾给出不同的票面；把一次结果当判断用之前，先复跑。
- **仪器会漂移。** 同一个 `provider/model` 名可能被换成不同的后端。实测中曾出现输出契约违规率从 2% 升到 33%、延迟从 46–92 秒塌到 17–22 秒，据此把整轮实验判为作废。**跨时间的对照，先验证「模型还是不是原来那个」。**
- **失败按保守默认处理。** 某一台没回话时，它那一票会被记为反对（安全优先）。报告顶部会写明 `⚠ 已表态：N/3 台`。
- **它不是法律或医疗意见。** 洞穴奇案在这里是**测量工具**，不是要它判对。
- **实测是小样本。** 6 个议题 × 3 轮 ＋ 同题复跑，不足以宣称任何统计意义上的稳定性。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <名> remove tri-sages
```

本地挂载的话，删掉 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那条 `insert` 条目即可。
**账本不会自动删**——位置见配置项 `ledgerDir`（默认 `<DSH_HOME>/tri-sages/`）。

## 开发

```bash
npm run test:offline   # 46 项，不需要 DSH 宿主（CI 跑这个）
npm test               # 54 项，多出的 8 项用宿主真实工具接口把插件挂载起来
node tools/probe-model.mjs   # 受控探测：绕开插件直连 provider，验证模型是否还遵守输出契约
```

`test/plugin.test.mjs` 是第一道防线：它证明插件**真能挂上去**（含「从 DSH 安装目录解析 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`」这一步——本地挂载最容易死在这里）。

改动见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)；实验材料见 [refs/](refs/README.md)。

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ChatGPT Adapter

**把 ChatGPT 订阅带进 DeepSeek Harness。登录账户，选择 GPT，即可开始工作。** 无需 API Key，支持 GPT / DeepSeek 切换、图片理解，以及 Harness 的文件、搜索和终端工具。 **仅适用于 DeepSeek Harness。** 本插件不能安装到 DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 或普通聊天桌面客户端中。支持 Harness 桌面版 ≥0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS；当前实测基线为 0.2.0-rc.2。 [快速开始](#快速开始) · [使用文档](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [下载安装包](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/releases/latest) · [English](README.en.md) ## 为什么使用 - **用自己的订阅**：通过 OpenAI 页面登录授权，无需配置 API Key。 - **两种模型，随时选择**：在会话中切换 GPT 与 DeepSeek，也可让新会话默认使用 GPT。 - **图片与工具一起用**：向支持图片的模型提问，使用 Harness 内置工具读取文件、编辑代码、搜索和运行命令。 - **思考强度可调**：在模型菜单中选择推理等级，档位与默认值自动匹配当前模型。 - **连接后即可选模型**：自动加载当前账户的可用模型，支持添加和切换多个账户。 - **插件独立代理**：在订阅设置页选择直连、环境变量或自定义 HTTP(S) 代理，支持测试连接，保存后立即生效。 - **免费开源**：MIT 许可；插件不额外收费。模型权限与使用额度取决于你的 ChatGPT 账户。 ## 快速开始 适用于 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 ≥0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS**，需要可使用订阅模型的 ChatGPT 账户。 ### 1. 安装插件 在 **Plugins → Add plugin** 中填入： ```text dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.8 ``` Registry 选择 **npm 官方源（https://registry.npmjs.org/）**，点击 **Install**。完成后，等当前任务结束，完全退出并重新打开 Harness。 > 若找不到切换源的入口，或安装失败，使用[终端安装或本地包安装](docs/INSTALLATION.md#其他安装方式)。 ### 2. 连接 ChatGPT 打开 **Settings → ChatGPT 订阅 → 连接 ChatGPT**，点击 **打开授权页面**，在 OpenAI 页面完成登录与授权。返回 Harness 后会自动显示连接状态和可用模型。 ### 3. 开始使用 新建会话，在模型选择器的 **ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT)** 下选择模型。 试着输入：`帮我阅读当前项目，说明它的用途。` 支持图片的模型也可以直接接收会话中添加的图片。 ## 常见问题 **这个插件支持哪个产品？** 仅支持 DeepSeek Harness。DeepSeek 普通网页版、手机 App 和普通聊天桌面客户端不支持安装本插件。支持 Harness 桌面版 ≥0.2.0-rc.2 / macOS；当前实测基线为 0.2.0-rc.2。 **如何在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅？** 安装 `dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.8`，在设置中连接自己的 ChatGPT 账户，再从 ChatGPT plan 中选择模型。无需 API Key，模型权限与额度由账户决定。 **可以直接填 GitHub 地址吗？** 这是源码地址：`https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter`。不同宿主与市场的安装器支持有差异，日常安装建议使用上面的明确包名与版本。 **已经连接，却没有模型？** 点击“刷新模型”，检查当前账户的订阅权限、额度及网络。模型列表以账户实际返回为准。 **如何升级？** 用相同包名安装新版本，然后完全退出并重开 Harness。保留原 Profile 和账户目录即可延续使用。 **如何退出或卸载？** 先在设置页退出账户，再到 Plugins 卸载。[详细说明](docs/PRIVACY.md#断开与卸载)。 ## 了解更多 [思考强度](docs/REASONING.md) · [安装与排错](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [兼容范围](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) · [数据与隐私](docs/PRIVACY.md) · [版本说明](RELEASE_NOTES.md) · [参与开发](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) 会话文本、所选图片和工具结果会发送至 OpenAI。登录凭证保存在本机未加密文件中，具有仅当前用户可读写的权限。本插件是独立社区项目，不隶属于 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek。 ### 插件头像 启用插件后，窗口右下角会显示「大肥鱼指挥 Codex」头像。图片随安装包提供，无需外部图片服务；头像不响应鼠标操作，不遮挡下方控件的点击。停用插件后自动移除。

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: 修复 VPN 下 web_fetch 被误判非公网地址
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-fetch-vpn

让 DSH 的 `web_fetch` 在开着 TUN / fake-IP 代理（Clash、Surge、sing-box 等）时照常工作。

## 现象

VPN 一开，`web_fetch` 对**任何**网址都报：

```
网页获取 · Error: URL hostname "api-docs.deepseek.com" resolves to a non-public IP address
```

关掉 VPN 立刻正常。`web_search` 不受影响（它走 DeepSeek API，不做本机地址校验）。

## 根因

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 是一条有意的 SSRF 防护：先把域名解析一次，只要答案里出现**非公网单播**地址就整组拒绝，再把校验过的地址钉进连接，防止解析与连接之间被换地址。

TUN 模式 + fake-IP 的代理会拦截 DNS，对任何域名都返回 `198.18.0.0/15` 里的合成地址（例如 `api-docs.deepseek.com → 198.18.0.240`）。这个地址不是目的地，隧道会在下一次 TCP connect 时把它路由到真实服务器 —— 但它在地址分类上属于「保留段」，于是被上面的防护全部拒掉，浏览器能力在 VPN 期间整体消失。

## 做法

插件**只替换「解析策略」这一步**，其余（跳转、字节上限、编码解码、系统代理路由、错误码）仍然由官方 provider 负责：

| 情况 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 DNS 返回的地址全是公网 | 原样通过，和官方行为完全一致 |
| 答案全在 `tunnelCidrs`（默认 `198.18.0.0/15`） | 视为**可连接**：隧道才是这些地址的真实目的地 |
| 答案里混有真正的私网 / 回环 / 链路本地 | 仍然拦截（防护没有被削弱） |
| 答案是 `0.0.0.0`、被污染或被 DNS 广告过滤拦掉 | 回退到 DNS-over-HTTPS，钉住真实公网地址 |
| 钉住 fake-IP 后连接失败（隧道没接管这个域名） | 对该主机强制 DoH 再重试一次，成功后 2 分钟内记住 |

它不注册新 provider，`web.fetchProvider: http` 保持不变 —— 因此**关掉这个 bundle 就等于还原官方行为**，不需要改任何配置。

## 模式

| mode | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `auto`（默认） | 接受隧道网段；连接失败时用 DoH 重试一次 |
| `passthrough` | 接受隧道网段，但从不重试（失败即失败） |
| `doh` | 跳过系统 DNS，直接用 DoH 解析真实地址（最快，但会绕过内网 split-horizon DNS） |
| `system` | 完全保持官方规则，用于对比排查 |

## 配置

配置在插件自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 row id `web-fetch-vpn` 覆盖）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: web-fetch-vpn
      name: dsh-web-fetch-vpn
      config:
        mode: auto
        tunnelCidrs:
          - 198.18.0.0/15      # Clash / Surge / sing-box 默认 fake-IP 段
        dohEndpoints:
          - https://dns.alidns.com/resolve
          - https://doh.pub/dns-query
          - https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query
          - https://dns.google/resolve
        dohTimeoutMs: 4000
        retryWithDoh: true
        log: false             # true 会把每次解析决策打到实例控制台
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `auto` | 见上表 |
| `tunnelCidrs` | `198.18.0.0/15` | 代理用来合成答案的网段；不确定就看你代理的 `fake-ip-range` |
| `dohEndpoints` | 阿里 / 腾讯 / Cloudflare / Google | 按顺序尝试，第一个给出公网地址的胜出 |
| `dohTimeoutMs` | `4000` | 单个 DoH 查询预算 |
| `cacheTtlMs` | `60000` | DoH 结果缓存，避免一次页面抓取打多次查询 |
| `preferDoh` | `false` | `true` = 所有域名都先走 DoH（等价于全局 `doh` 模式，但保留系统 DNS 兜底） |
| `retryWithDoh` | `true` | 连接失败后是否用 DoH 重试一次 |
| `log` | `false` | 解析决策日志 |

也可以用环境变量临时改：`DSH_WEB_FETCH_VPN_MODE=system`、`DSH_WEB_FETCH_VPN_LOG=1`。

## 验证

```powershell
# 纯策略测试（不联网部分也能跑：加 --offline）
node test/selftest.mjs

# 端到端：同一台机器上先复现官方报错，再用本插件的策略真的抓下页面
node test/e2e-live.mjs https://api-docs.deepseek.com/
```

`test/e2e-live.mjs` 需要一个 DSH 运行时；用 `DSH_RUNTIME` 指过去，例如
`$env:DSH_RUNTIME = 'D:\path\to\dsh\runtime'`。

## 安装 / 卸载

安装就是「往 profile 里加一个 bundle」：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

也可以在插件页里安装/开关。装好即生效：base bundle 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` 监听
profile manifest，`dsh.profile.bundles` 一变就重合成并当场装载，不需要重启。

> 例外：改 `package.json` 的 `exports` / `files`（例如新增 `locale/*.json`）**必须重启**。
> Node 按进程缓存 package.json 的 `exports`，运行中的实例看不到新增的导出；而插件页文案
> 走 app-boot 的 `readPluginMeta()`，它要靠 exports 才能解析到 `locale/en.json`。

卸载：把 bundle 从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里去掉（或用插件页的开关关掉），保存即热生效；关掉即恢复官方行为，无需改其它配置。

## 边界

- 不碰 `web_search`：搜索走 API，本来就不受 fake-IP 影响。
- 系统代理模式（`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`）本来就不做本机解析，插件不会介入。
- `doh` / `preferDoh` 会用公网 DNS 的答案，可能绕过内网 split-horizon 域名；默认 `auto` 只在系统答案不可用时才这么做。
- 纯 Node 内置模块实现（`node:net` 的 `BlockList`、`node:dns`、全局 `fetch`），没有 npm 依赖，也不锁定 DSH 版本；唯一依赖的运行时契约是官方 provider 实例上的 `resolveAddresses` 字段（探测不到就原样放过并记一条日志）。

plugins.description: Agent preset 检查器：看清每个 preset 的层来源、装配树、提示词与工具（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-preset-inspector

Agent preset 检查器：看清每个 preset 的层来源、装配树、提示词与工具（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

## 为什么需要它 设置页的「查看配置」只给你一份 YAML 文本：没有来源、没有包信息、没有层次。可 preset 的实际行为是**多层补丁叠出来的**——`dsh-base` 声明一行、`dsh-web-app` 改它、你的 `cordis.patch.yml` 再改一次。最后哪个值生效、这行是谁加的，全藏在多份文件里。 Preset Inspector 把同一份装配拆成三种看法： - **模型输入**：当前 preset 实际收到的系统提示词、动态上下文和工具定义； - **插件树**：每个 preset 由哪些插件行组成，每行来自哪一层； - **补丁层**：整个 profile 的 bundle / profile / home 补丁栈，以及每层执行的 insert / replace config / disable。 它只读，不改任何 preset 或配置。 ## 安装 直接装 git 源： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:omdsh-dev/dsh-preset-inspector ``` 装完重启 `dsh web`。本包依赖宿主注入官方包，**不要用本地目录 `link:` 安装**。 离线或需要固定产物时，可以用 release 里的 tarball： ```sh pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-preset-inspector-*.tgz ``` ## 用起来是什么样 在 **Settings → Agent presets** 的任意 preset 卡片上点「检查」打开面板。面板内可切换 preset，不需要另开入口。 ![Settings 入口](docs/preview/settings-entry.png) ### 模型输入 系统提示词按类型分组（身份 / 人设 / 工具引导…）。点「显示来源」可以看到每段的段名、来源和包名；不显示时页面只保留正文。 - **System Prompt**：按 `order` 排列；完整 section 规则由真实 assembly 决定。 - **动态注入**：每个 context 槽位可点击，查看 `order`、必需/可选、归属和装配说明。 - **工具定义**：模型侧真实 schema；工具名、描述、参数和提供方。搜索框可过滤。 ![动态上下文详情](docs/preview/context-detail.png) ### 插件树 / 补丁层 插件树展示每行插件、分类、包名、工具列表，以及插入/修改/禁用的层信息。补丁层展示每层实际执行的 ops；`config` patch 会标成整体替换，避免误以为是按 key 合并。 ## 能力面 | 能力 | 说明 | |---|---| | 模型输入 | 系统提示词、动态注入、工具定义；自动捕获 Agent setup 结果 | | 来源显示 | 「显示来源」按需显示段名/来源/包名和工具提供方 | | 插件树 | preset 的插件行、分类、工具、layers | | 补丁层 | bundle → profile → home 的补丁栈与 ops | | 官方设置入口 | Settings → Agent presets 卡片上的「检查」（唯一入口，不占侧栏） | | 兼容性 | 浅/深色、中/英、390px 窄屏、键盘焦点 | ## 已知限制 - **只读**；但为了拿到 Agent setup 阶段的数据，后台会自动执行一次 preset setup。它不发送模型请求；第三方插件在 setup 中可能有文件/网络等副作用。 - Agent/session 条件才注册的工具或提示词段不会出现在 mount 快照里；以实际会话为准。 - 层栈来自请求时读取的磁盘配置；CLI overlay、telemetry patch 和已热协调的内存树不在回放范围内。 - `config` patch 是整体替换，不是按 key 合并。 - 静态扫描只作为兜底，仍是启发式，复杂运行时拼接可能漏/多列。 - 同一 group 内重复 id 的行用 `#2` 区分；删除前一个同名行时序号会前移，极端情况下来源会显示为 patch。 - Settings 卡片上的「检查」是 DOM 装饰：官方 0.2.1 没有 per-card slot，官方卡片结构变化时入口会暂时消失（插件不再提供侧栏备用入口）。面板挂在 `shell.overlay`，打开事件监听和卡片装饰都由它维护。 - dry-run 在 `0.2.1-rc.1` 实测不留下新 session 文件，但依赖 factory rollback 语义；升级 dsh 后需要重新验证。 更多实现细节与验证证据见 [docs/engineering-notes.md](docs/engineering-notes.md)。 ## 插件管理 装/卸/启停用官方 CLI：`dsh plugin --profile web add|remove <包>`；已装插件在**侧边栏 Plugins 页**里查看与配置。 ## 兼容性 | dsh 版本 | 状态 | |---|---| | `0.2.1-rc.1` | ✅ 已验证（2026-10-17，隔离 DSH_HOME：tarball 安装、mount assembly、dry-run、Settings 入口、三视角、浅/深色、中/英、390px 窄屏、键盘焦点） | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | ⚠️ 未验证——段名/服务名若有差异，模型输入可能显示“运行时”而非模板 | ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH 侧栏网页批注：真浏览器跑在宿主里，指向元素就地批注，汇总成结构化指令。In-sidebar web annotation with real element picking for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-annotate

在 DSH 侧栏里跑一个真实浏览器，指向页面元素就地写批注，汇总成结构化指令。

Point at a live element inside the DSH sidebar, drop a comment on it, and get back a structured instruction list.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.1%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0284c7.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> 装不上、报错、或者行为和文档对不上，直接发邮件到 **1992335297@qq.com**，比开 Issue 更快被看到。

---

![侧栏网页批注](docs/annotate.png)

> 图为界面示意，按插件 `lib/client.js` 的工具栏、拾取高亮、元素信息与批注列表样式渲染，页面内容为假数据，不是运行截图。可用 `node scripts/make-screenshots.mjs` 重新生成（源码在 `scripts/demo/annotate.html`）。

## 它解决什么问题

改界面最累的不是改，是指路。「左边那个卡片的边距大了点」——模型得猜是哪个卡片；截一张图贴进去——又得反复圈。批注把指路变成点一下：鼠标停在哪个元素上，它的标签、尺寸、背景色、字体就摆在那儿，点一下写一句人话，最后汇总成一份带选择器的清单。

## 功能

- **真实浏览器**：宿主侧用 Playwright 起 Chromium，页面是真跑的，不是画出来的缩略图。
- **画面推流**：CDP `Page.startScreencast` 出帧，SSE 推到侧栏，页面一有变化就刷新。
- **元素拾取**：开启批注模式后，鼠标指向哪里，就高亮哪个元素并显示 `标签 / 尺寸 / 背景色 / 字体 / 字号 / 字重`。
- **就地评论**：点元素弹出输入框，回车即存；批注列表在下方可逐条删除。
- **框选区域**：按住拖动可以框一块区域批注，适合「这一整块间距不对」这类说不清是哪个元素的意见。
- **一键回填**：点 **↩** 把汇总直接写进对话输入框，不用复制粘贴。
- **快捷键**：`Ctrl+Shift+.` 切换批注模式。
- **交互转发**：退出拾取后，点击、滚轮、方向键、Enter、Tab、Esc、Backspace、PageUp/PageDown 都会转发给页面。
- **批注留得住**：按页面地址存在 `localStorage`，关掉 tab 再打开还在；删完自动清空。
- **穿透 iframe**：页面里嵌的 iframe（含跨域）也能点进去拾取，信息浮层会标出所在层级。
- **页面内输入**：工具栏 `⌨` 把一段文本（含中文）送进页面当前焦点元素，绕开键盘布局与输入法。
- **导出成文件**：`⤓` 把汇总写成 Markdown，存到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/` 下。

## 汇总长这样

```markdown
## 网页批注

页面：http://localhost:5173/

1. `#card-a`（div，936×54）
   卡片内边距太大，收到 12px

2. `#card-b.accent`（div，936×54）
   强调色换成主题蓝
```

## 用法

1. 点右侧栏 tab 条的添加按钮，选 **网页批注**。
2. 地址栏输入 `localhost:5173`，回车。首次启动浏览器要等几秒。
3. 点工具栏的 **◱ 批注**（或按 `Ctrl+Shift+.`）进入拾取模式。指向元素看信息，点一下写评论；按住拖动可以框一块区域。
4. 点 **↩** 把汇总回填到输入框，或点 **⧉** 复制到剪贴板。

退出拾取模式后，点击和滚轮会正常传给页面，可以当普通预览用。

## 与 dsh-web-preview 的分工

| | dsh-web-preview | dsh-web-annotate |
|---|---|---|
| 渲染 | iframe 直出 | CDP 画面流 |
| 速度 | 接近原生 | 帧流，有几十毫秒延迟 |
| 能否批注 | 否（跨域拿不到 DOM） | 能 |
| 依赖 | 无 | 需要 Playwright（复用 DSH 自带的那份） |

两个插件可以同时装，各自一个 tab 类型。

## 技术实现

```
宿主 lib/index.js
  ├─ 从 DSH profile 目录解析 playwright，复用 DSH 自带的 chromium
  ├─ 每个地址一个 page 会话，CDP screencast 出帧
  ├─ SSE  GET  /api/web-annotate/frames?session=<id>
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/session      创建会话
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/input        鼠标 / 滚轮 / 键盘转发
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/pick         坐标 → 元素信息（elementFromPoint）
  ├─ POST /api/web-annotate/reload       重新加载
  └─ DEL  /api/web-annotate/session/<id> 关闭
```

没用 WebSocket：DSH 的 `webServer` 只暴露路由注册，不保证能拿到 http server 的 `upgrade` 事件。SSE 是普通响应，稳定可控；输入事件走 POST，量级完全够。

选择器生成走 `id` → 类名 → `nth-of-type` 的降级链，最多上溯 6 层。

## 权限与安全边界

这个插件比纯前端插件权限大，装之前请明确知道它做了什么。

- **会启动本地浏览器进程**：使用 DSH 自带的 Playwright 与 Chromium，不额外下载。
- **会访问你输入的地址**：只放行 `http` / `https`，拒绝 `file://` 与其它协议，不能读取本地文件。
- **不注入任意脚本**：页面内只执行一个固定的取元素信息函数，不执行页面返回的内容。
- **不写入文件**：批注只存在客户端内存里，复制由你自己触发。
- **会话隔离**：每个地址一个 page，关闭 tab 即销毁；无客户端连接且空闲 5 分钟后自动回收。
- `dependencies` 为空，无 `preinstall` / `install` / `postinstall` / `prepare` 生命周期脚本。

## 已知限制

- 画面是帧流，快速滚动或动画多时会有轻微延迟。
- 拾取模式会拦截点击与滚动，要操作页面（点按钮、输入）需先退出拾取。
- 键盘只转发导航键与编辑键（方向键、Enter、Tab、Esc、Backspace、PageUp/PageDown）；可打印字符走 `⌨` 面板的整段输入，逐字键入不转。
- 回填依赖 DSH 的 `conversation.input.left` 插槽存在。该插槽没挂上时自动退回复制到剪贴板。
- iframe 穿透最多 4 层；超出的部分会被当成普通 iframe 元素本身。
- 导出固定写到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/`，不写项目目录。
- 批注存在 `localStorage`，按页面地址分键；换浏览器 profile 或清理站点数据会丢。
- 只在 Windows + DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` 桌面端验证过。

## 开发与验证

```bash
node scripts/verify.mjs   # 静态 + 路由级，17 项，不启动浏览器
node scripts/smoke.mjs    # 端到端：起站点、起 chromium、取帧、拾取、输入、刷新、关闭，8 项
```

`smoke.mjs` 会真起一个本地 HTTP 站点和 Chromium，实测输出形如：

```
PASS  创建会话并打开页面
      frame=13351 bytes, device=1000x700
PASS  SSE 收到首帧画面
      picked <div> #card-a 936x54
      bg=rgb(255, 255, 255) font=16px / system-ui
PASS  拾取元素返回标签与样式
...
结果: 8 passed, 0 failed
```

## 安装

### 一条命令

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:nubeslove/dsh-web-annotate"
```

然后在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-web-annotate"`，重启 DSH。

插件本身不含运行时依赖；Playwright 在运行时从 DSH profile 目录解析，复用 DSH 自带的 Chromium，不会额外下载浏览器。

### 本地开发

自己改代码时用 link 指向工作副本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-annotate"
```

路径含空格时手工处理：在 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-web-annotate": "link:E:/path/to/dsh-web-annotate"`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `"dsh-web-annotate"`，并在 `profiles/desktop/node_modules/` 下建指向本目录的 Junction，然后重启 DSH。

## 更新记录

- **0.3.0** — 攻克三处硬限制：拾取可递归穿透 iframe（`frame.childFrames()` 逐层进入子文档，跨域也能读，最多 4 层，浮层显示所在层级）；新增 `⌨` 页面文本输入面板，用 `keyboard.insertText` 送中文等任意字符；新增 `⤓` 导出，把汇总写成 Markdown 到 `~/.dsh/web-annotate/`。自检 19 项，冒烟 11 项。
- **0.2.0** — 批注汇总可直接回填输入框（在 `conversation.input.left` 挂桥接组件拿到 `inputActions`，桥不可用时退回复制）；新增 `Ctrl+Shift+.` 快捷键、拖动框选区域、方向键与编辑键转发、批注 `localStorage` 持久化。自检增至 17 项。
- **0.1.0** — 首个版本。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

## 反馈与联系 / Feedback & Contact

遇到 bug、安装失败、行为和文档不一致，或者想要某个功能，都可以直接发邮件。

**邮箱：1992335297@qq.com**

邮件里带上这三样，定位会快很多：

- 插件版本（`package.json` 里的 `version`）
- DSH 版本（`dsh --version`）
- 报错的完整文字或截图

也可以在 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nubeslove/dsh-web-annotate/issues) 提，但邮件更快。

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; plugins.description: Reviso for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): publish agent output for human review and find it again from the session
plugins.readme_text:
# reviso-dsh

Reviso for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — the DSH surface of the Reviso family.

| repo | surface |
|---|---|
| `reviso` | product (backend + web) |
| `reviso-agent` | agent skill (any agent, platform-agnostic) |
| `reviso-cli` | CLI |
| **`reviso-dsh`** | DSH host integration (this repo) |

## Status: Phase 1 — visible client face (verified in a live browser)

Implemented, two views:
- Sidebar entry (`sidebar.footer.action`, beside Settings) + `shell.overlay` panel — ALL Reviso documents for the user.
- Session view tab (`conversation.view`, id `reviso-dsh.view`, beside chat | trajectory) — documents produced by THIS session (binding key `session_key = dsh:<sessionId>`, served once the reviso L0 contract lands).
Demo mode (labeled 演示) is the default; fill Server + Token in the panel's
连接设置 to hit a real deployment (auth: `Authorization: Bearer <automation
key or account-agent token>`; the deployment must allow this origin via
`REVISO_CORS_ALLOWLIST`).

Slot/build contract: see docs/client-face-contract.md.

Minimal DSH bundle that loads under the harness. Roadmap:

1. **Phase 0 (here)** — bundle skeleton, load-verified locally.
2. **Phase 1** — Reviso HTTP client: publish/read with `source_kind` +
   `source_session_id` (normalized to `session_key`); requires the L0 contract
   in the `reviso` main repo (`document_sources` sidecar + read APIs).
3. **Phase 2** — Agent Inbox tab + per-session "back to session" openers
   (client-face spike against DSH's browser extension contract).

## Concepts (per DSH docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)

- A **bundle** is an npm package shipping a config layer: `package.json`
  declares `dsh.bundle` → its `cordis.patch.yml` inserts plugin rows that
  reference the package **by name**.
- A **profile** is what a user boots (`dsh --profile <name>`); `dsh plugin`
  maintains it. Layer order: profile bundles → profile patch → home patch →
  `--patch` overlays.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/reviso-dsh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config   # expect a "# == dsh-reviso" layer
```

## Local dev

Scratch form uses an absolute source path (paths must be absolute):

```yaml
# dev.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: reviso-dsh
      name: '/absolute/path/to/reviso-dsh/index.js'
```

```sh
pnpm dsh web --patch ./dev.patch.yml
```

## Contract

The cross-repo contract (Reviso HTTP API + `source_kind` enum
`dsh|claude|codex|cursor|mcp` + `session_key = kind:normalized_id`) is owned by
the `reviso` main repo (L0). This package never talks to Supabase directly.

Tested with dsh `0.1.0-rc.8`.

## See it locally

`sh
pnpm install && pnpm run build:client   # produce lib/client.js
dsh plugin --profile web add /Users/touchskyer/Code/reviso-projects/reviso-dsh
dsh web                                  # Reviso entry sits beside Settings in the sidebar
`

Rollback: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-reviso`.

## License

MIT — same as `reviso-agent` / `reviso-cli`.
