| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` | plugin root relative to `cwd` |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` |

Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`), DeepSeek Harness (`dsh/`) and the WorkBuddy example (`hosts/workbuddy/mcp.json`) are also present. In a development checkout you must build the editor assets first; cloning the source is not an installed runtime.

## Quick start

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Install plugin] --> B[Restart and open a task]
    B --> C[open_editor]
    C --> D{editor_status ready?}
    D -->|No| C
    D -->|Yes| E[new_workbook]
    E --> F[set_cell / write_range]
    F --> G[evaluate_formula]
    G --> H[inspect_workbook / save_workbook]
```

1. Open the editor with an explicit `workspace` argument.
2. Create a workbook with `new_workbook`, or open an existing file with `open_workbook`.
3. Read the available commands first with `list_commands`, then use `execute_command` for anything the direct tools do not cover.
4. Write values with `set_cell` or `write_range`, and confirm calculations with `evaluate_formula` — never assume a formula recalculated.
5. Save with `save_workbook`, reopen, and check that formulas and formats survived.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Clean a messy table | `gridcraft-clean-table` | Deduplicated, gap-checked, format-normalised sheet |
| Sales summary | `gridcraft-sales-summary` | Totals by period, product or region with live formulas |
| Budget versus actual | `gridcraft-budget-tracker` | Budget, actual and variance columns that recalculate |
| Reconcile two tables | `gridcraft-reconcile-data` | Matched, unmatched and exception rows |
| Formula audit | `gridcraft-formula-audit` | Broken references, hardcoded values and missing ranges listed |
| Business dashboard | `gridcraft-dashboard` | Metric cells, charts and filters on one sheet |
| Shift timesheet | `gridcraft-shift-timesheet` | Cross-midnight hours and break handling |
| Fixed-rate payment schedule | `gridcraft-fixed-payment` | Principal, rate and term turned into monthly rows |
| Month calendar | `gridcraft-month-calendar` | Weekday-accurate grid including leap years |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `gridcraft-editor` | Open the editor in the host and keep agent edits on the same page |
| `gridcraft-clean-table` | Handle duplicates, missing values and inconsistent formats |
| `gridcraft-sales-summary` | Aggregate sales by time, product or region |
| `gridcraft-budget-tracker` | Manage budget, actual and variance |
| `gridcraft-reconcile-data` | Compare orders, statements or stock between two tables |
| `gridcraft-formula-audit` | Find broken references, hardcoded numbers and range gaps |
| `gridcraft-dashboard` | Metrics, charts and filters on one sheet |
| `gridcraft-shift-timesheet` | Cross-midnight shifts, break hours, missing and invalid rows |
| `gridcraft-fixed-payment` | Fixed nominal annual rate and equal monthly payments |
| `gridcraft-month-calendar` | Month grid with Monday start, weekend columns and leap years |
| `gridcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Recipes for quotes, replenishment, weighted scoring, expense review, duplicate keys and task tables |

Skills come from the independent `gridcraft-skills` source and are pinned by `scenario-candidates.json` with per-skill SHA-256 digests.

## MCP tools

One bundled server, `gridcraft-editor`, speaking **stdio**. The local HTTP listener only serves the editor page and its same-session bridge. The catalogue exposes 29 tools: 24 agent-callable tools and 5 `_editor_*` bridge tools the panel uses internally.

| Family | Tools | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Session | `open_editor`, `open_browser_editor`, `editor_status` | Open the editor and confirm that it attached |
| Discovery | `list_commands`, `list_functions` | Live command IDs, parameters, and supported spreadsheet functions |
| Command gateway | `execute_command` | Run any registered engine command with JSON params |
| Workbook | `new_workbook`, `open_workbook`, `save_workbook`, `inspect_workbook` | Create, open, save and summarise a workbook |
| Cells and ranges | `set_cell`, `get_cell`, `read_range`, `write_range` | Read and write individual cells or rectangular ranges |
| Calculation | `evaluate_formula` | Evaluate a formula expression without changing any cell |
| Structure | `create_table`, `sort_range`, `filter`, `format_range` | Tables, ordering, filtering and cell formatting |
| Charts | `insert_chart` | Insert a chart bound to a range |
| Interaction | `select`, `screenshot` | Select a range; `screenshot` saves a window PNG (desktop app) |
| History | `undo`, `redo` | Step back and forward one change |

## Configuration

| Setting | Where | Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `workspace` argument | `open_editor` / `open_browser_editor` | Binds the task folder; paths outside it are refused |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | stdio MCP `env` | Use the bundled editor only; no download attempt |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Environment | Absolute directory for verified editor archives |
| `CRAFT_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | Host MCP config | Workspace root for hosts that cannot pass it in a tool call |

Verified archives are cached under

plugins.description: Draw, inspect, and export 2D CAD drawings, with a reopened DXF check before delivery.
plugins.readme_text:
# CADCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![CADCraft Use — precise 2D drafting](assets/official-logo.png)

> Draw, inspect, render, and save 2D CAD geometry through CADCraft's own command engine, with entity counts and a reopened DXF checked before delivery.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-12-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`cadcraft` lets an agent drive CADCraft's existing command registry instead of inventing a second CAD engine: start a drawing, run native commands, inspect entities, render the sheet, and save a DXF that reopens with the expected geometry. It packages twelve skills, a portable manifest, and one embedded editor server.

This is a development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, the current build is still pending public release, and GUI acceptance, desktop UI control, and external CAD compatibility remain separate open gates.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `cadcraft` |
| Display name | CADCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.4` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | CADCraft 0.3.0 command registry; editor build bundled, CLI external |
| Marketplace | `cadcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded end-to-end evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Headless file tasks and the `cadcraft-cli` skill need an installed `cadcraft-cli` on the host. The plugin does not install it. Build or install it from the upstream CADCraft project, then check `cadcraft-cli --version` and `cadcraft-cli commands` in the host environment.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or a verified editor cache. `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` uses bundled assets.
- `CADCRAFT_CLI` selects a binary only for `scripts/launch.py`; it does not change the editor entry in `mcp.json`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add cadcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

This candidate is still marked as pending public release, with `releaseStatus: BLOCKED`. To test the exact build, use the repository-local marketplace `cadcraft-marketplace`, pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.4`. Restart the host, open a new task, and ask for one small drawing before a full sheet.

## Quick start

1. Open the editor with an absolute workspace: “Open CADCraft for this folder and list the available commands.”
2. Query the live command registry before drawing. Do not treat a skill example as the complete schema; parameters and enabled state come from the installed version.
3. Run one bounded command, for example a circle at `[10,10]` with radius `4`, then inspect the drawing and confirm the expected entity count.
4. Save to a **new absolute** `.dxf` path, reopen that exact file, and inspect again. Agree on any overwrite before saving over an existing file.

```text
Draw: Create a 120 × 80 mm plate with four 6 mm holes on a 20 mm inset.
Inspect: List circles, lines, layers, and the handle of each new entity.
Bolt circle: Place six holes on a 60 mm pitch-circle diameter starting at 0°.
Export: Save the sheet to a new DXF, reopen it, and verify entity counts.
```

Direct runtime checks for the external CLI and the optional launcher:

```bash
cadcraft-cli --version
cadcraft-cli commands
python3 scripts/launch.py --doctor
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Draw and inspect parts | `cadcraft-use`, `cadcraft-mcp` | Entity types, counts, handles, layers, and key coordinates |
| Parametric hole patterns | `cadcraft-bolt-circle` | Polar array from a real handle, hole count and pitch circle checked |
| Room plans | `cadcraft-floor-plan` | Room outline, openings, and wall geometry at stated dimensions |
| Dimensions and layers | `cadcraft-dimension-part`, `cadcraft-layer-cleanup` | Part dimensions, cleaned layers, linetypes, duplicates |
| Sheet output | `cadcraft-sheet-export` | Frame, paper, scale, and print output |
| Revision comparison | `cadcraft-compare-revisions` | Geometry and annotation differences between two drawings |
| Trace a reference | `cadcraft-trace-reference` | Two-axis calibration and a dimensioned vector outline |
| Scripted scenarios | `cadcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes with real methods, parameters, and reopen checks |
| Visual editing | `cadcraft-editor` | Same-session UI plus a saved drawing file |

## Skills

### Entry and runtime

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cadcraft-use` | Choose the CLI or MCP path and define what a verified drawing means |
| `cadcraft-cli` | Run headless file tasks with the installed `cadcraft-cli` |
| `cadcraft-mcp` | Drive interactive, JSON, query, and render tools over MCP, including failure checks |

### Drawing scenarios

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cadcraft-bolt-circle` | Build an equal-angle bolt pattern from a real handle and polar array |
| `cadcraft-floor-plan` | Draw rooms, doors, and windows at given dimensions |
| `cadcraft-dimension-part` | Dimension a mechanical part profile, holes, and sizes |
| `cadcraft-layer-cleanup` | Clean layers, linetypes, and duplicate lines in a complex drawing |
| `cadcraft-sheet-export` | Produce a sheet with frame, paper, scale, and print output |
| `cadcraft-compare-revisions` | Compare geometry and annotations between two drawing versions |
| `cadcraft-trace-reference` | Rebuild a dimensioned outline from confirmed reference control points |

### Playbooks and editor

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cadcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight scenarios covering plates, flanges, door openings, grids, routing, hole rows, notches, and title frames |
| `cadcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `cadcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the bundled engine's command catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Default native design panel, registered as a conversation-side entrypoint; pass the absolute task `workspace` |
| `open_browser_editor` | Explicit browser fallback for the same session; normal editor opening does not require this tool |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready to accept commands |

The bundled catalog in `ui/catalog.lock.json` exposes `command_line`, `script`, `execute`, `list_commands`, `inspect_drawing`, `query_entities`, `render`, `new_drawing`, `open`, and `save`, plus UI tools when a desktop session is attached. `render` produces an image of drawing content, not a screenshot of an application window; `screenshot`, `ui_inspect`, and `ui_click` require a desktop control connection.

The default entry declares a thread entrypoint and a separate design surface. Tool metadata, resource metadata, and UI initialization all request `fullscreen`, which desktop hosts present as a separate conversation panel. `open_editor` does not return a browser

plugins.description: QQ 官方机器人通道插件 for DeepSeek Harness — talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-qq-bot

把 **QQ 官方机器人**（q.qq.com 开放平台）接成 DeepSeek Harness 的一个输入通道：
在 QQ 群里 @机器人 或在私聊里发消息 → DSH 用对应会话处理 → 回答回到 QQ。

一个 QQ 用户 / 一个 QQ 群固定对应一个 DSH Session（id 形如 `session-qq-c2c-<openid>`、
`session-qq-group-<group_openid>`），所以多轮上下文由 DSH 自己的会话持久化维护，
插件不额外维护映射表；在 GUI 里能直接看到并归档这些会话。

## 一、先在 QQ 侧准备

1. 打开 <https://q.qq.com>，用 QQ 号登录「QQ 开放平台」，创建**机器人**应用（个人主体也能建）。
2. 在「开发设置」里拿到 **AppID** 和 **AppSecret（客户端密钥）**。
3. 在「功能配置」里开启 **单聊**（私聊）和 / 或 **群聊** 场景。群聊场景需要在
   「沙箱配置」里把你自己的测试群加进去（新版群/单聊机器人没有沙箱域名，
   管理员账号本身就是测试账号，直接用真实环境）。
4. 群聊场景下，机器人需要被拉进群；测试期建议只把小号/测试群加进去。

> 官方文档：<https://bot.q.qq.com/wiki/develop/api-v2/>

## 二、把凭据交给插件

三种方式，按优先级：**插件配置 → 环境变量 → 凭据文件**。

推荐第三种（不把密钥写进 profile 补丁）：

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/qq-bot.json
{
  "appId": "你的 AppID",
  "clientSecret": "你的 AppSecret"
}
```

或设环境变量 `DSH_QQ_APP_ID` / `DSH_QQ_CLIENT_SECRET`。
也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写：

```yaml
- id: qq-bot
  name: dsh-plugin-qq-bot
  config:
    appId: "..."
    clientSecret: "..."
```

**凭据文件会被轮询**：补上或修改 `~/.dsh/qq-bot.json` 后，插件在几秒内自动连上网关，
**不需要重启 DeepSeek Harness**（`credentialsPollMs` 控制轮询间隔）。
只有改动插件**配置项**（`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `config:`）才需要重启。

## 三、配置项

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 关掉后插件只写状态文件、不连网关 |
| `appId` / `clientSecret` | `""` | 留空则走环境变量 / 凭据文件 |
| `apiBase` | `https://api.bot.qq.com` | 官方接口根地址（2026-08-10 起统一域名） |
| `intents` | `33554432` | `1<<25`，同时覆盖群聊@与单聊 |
| `agentPreset` | `standard` | 这些会话使用的 Agent 预设（也是平台默认预设） |
| `workspace` | `~/.dsh/qq-bot-workspace` | 会话工作目录；想让它操作某个项目就指过去 |
| `allowOpenIds` | `[]` | 只响应这些 openid / group_openid；留空不限制 |
| `replyChunkChars` | `1500` | 单条消息最大字符数，超出分片发送 |
| `maxWaitMs` | `900000` | 单轮最长等待；超时先把已有内容发出去 |
| `ackAfterMs` | `12000` | 超过这么久还没答就先回一句「正在处理」；`0` 关闭 |
| `ackText` | `收到，正在处理…` | 上面那句的文案 |
| `credentialsFile` | `~/.dsh/qq-bot.json` | 凭据文件路径 |
| `credentialsPollMs` | `5000` | 轮询凭据文件内容变化的间隔（毫秒） |

## 四、怎么确认它跑起来了

状态会写到 `~/.dsh/qq-bot-state.json`：

```jsonc
{
  "status": "ready",          // starting / connecting / ready / closed / reconnecting / missing-credentials
  "lastMessageAt": 1760000000000,
  "lastSessionId": "session-qq-c2c-XXXXXXXX",
  "lastSummary": "[正常完成，12.3s]",
  "events": [ { "at": 1760000000000, "message": "info: access_token 已获取，有效期 7200s" } ]
}
```

- `missing-credentials` → 凭据没被读到；补上文件后插件会**自动**重试，不用重启。
- `closed` / `reconnecting` 反复出现 → 看 `events` 里的日志：
  - 日志里带 `（这通常是 AppID / AppSecret 不对…）` 或 `机器人不存在` → 凭据或平台配置问题。
  - 服务端以 4013/4014 断开 → `intents` 没权限（群 + 单聊要 `33554432`）。
  - 先出现 `access_token 已获取` 再断开 → 凭据没问题，检查平台上的场景/群配置。

> 已实测（2026-10-14）：`api.bot.qq.com` 同时提供 access_token 与 OpenAPI；用无效
> AppID 请求 token 会返回 **HTTP 200** + `{"code":10004,"message":"机器人不存在"}`，
> 所以判定成败必须看 body 里的 `code`（插件已按此实现）。

## 五、行为细节

- **被动回复优先**：群里 5 分钟内、单聊 60 分钟内，用收到的那条消息的 `msg_id`
  回复（群里最多 5 条、单聊最多 4 条，`msg_seq` 递增）。超出窗口或次数后自动改走普通消息。
- **同一个会话串行**：同一个 QQ 用户/群的多条消息排队处理，不会互相打断；
  不同会话并行。
- **超时保护**：单轮超过 `maxWaitMs` 会把当前已有的文本先发出去，并在末尾标注超时。
- **回复末尾会附一行状态**，例如 `[正常完成，12.3s]`，方便知道这轮是怎么结束的。
- **两条本地指令**（不占用 DSH 轮次，用来快速确认链路通不通）：
  - `/ping` → 回 `pong ✅` 加网关状态、凭据来源、本会话 id
  - `/help` → 回一段使用说明

## 六、开发与测试

```bash
# 单元测试（不需要 DSH、不需要网络）
node --test
```

测试覆盖：文本分片、事件归一化、桥接投递顺序与串行、以及用一个假 WebSocket +
假 fetch 跑完整的「Hello → Identify → READY → 收消息 → 被动回复 → 过期回退主动消息」链路。

## 七、写 DSH 插件时踩到的两个坑

这两条都是**真实联调时才暴露**的，跟 QQ 无关，任何 DSH 插件都可能遇到。

**1. `sessionController.prompt(request, signal)` 的 `signal` 不能省。**
它的 `@Remote` 门面第一行是 `signal.throwIfAborted()`，且**没有 `?.` 兜底**：

```js
prompt(request, signal) {
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  return this.commands.prompt(request);
}
```

少传第二个参数就报 `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'throwIfAborted')`。
官方服务契约里只写 `prompt(request, signal)`，看不出哪个参数可省 —— 实测 `create` 和
`resolveAgent` 都不需要 signal，只有 `prompt` 需要。
本插件在测试里用一个「复刻真实契约」的假 `sessionController` 看住这一点。

**2. 改完插件代码，重新挂载**不**等于加载新代码。**
ESM 模块按 URL 缓存，`dsh plugin add` 重新装、或把 bundle 关掉再打开，插件会重新
`apply()`（状态文件里的挂载时间会变），但**跑的还是缓存住的旧模块**。只有重启
DSH 进程才会真正换代码。

插件为此在状态文件里写了 `codeVersion`；`node tools/check.mjs` 会直接告诉你当前
进程跑的是哪一版，缺失就说明还是旧模块。

## 八、许可

MIT

# dsh-llm-probe

**一句话**：把任意 OpenAI 兼容端点当**测量装置**跑实验——只回读数，正文落盘不进上下文。 **为什么值得用**：手写脚本跑实验的根因是**正文会灌爆上下文**（一次 30 条 prompt 的回复就能吃掉几万 token）。本插件只把**读数**带回上下文（调用数/失败数/延迟分位/字符数分布/正文 sha256/落盘路径），正文写进 JSONL 留给事后分析。配 `llmprobe_calib` 的「**标定先行**」——在测因变量之前先验证「档位真的构成梯度」（这一条是三轮实验作废换来的纪律）。 ## 工具 - `llmprobe_run`：对任意 OpenAI 兼容端点跑一批 prompt（prompts × reps），**只回读数**：调用数/失败数/延迟分位/字符数分布/正文 sha256/落盘路径——模型正文写进 JSONL 落盘、**不进上下文**（今晚手写 8 个脚本的根因就是正文会灌爆上下文）。给 extract 正则时额外回抽取值的分布统计。端点不可达 ⇒ ok:false + 原因（不是空结果）。 - `llmprobe_calib`：**标定先行**（今晚三轮实验作废换来的第一纪律）：在测因变量之前，先验证「档位真的构成梯度」。对每档一个条件（如不同的 system），跑同一批探针，算各档指标均值与档间最大差 disp，再与调用者**显式给定**的无分辨力线比较，回三态裁决：has-resolution / no-resolution / apparatus-down。noiseFloor 必填且无默认——判据不可代填。 ## 生态契约 > 依据《DSH 插件生态倡议书》三条原则：**组合优先 / 声明清晰 / 兼容优先**。 - **依赖 service**（`inject`）：`tools` —— 组合行装载时等待这些 service - **贡献面**：工具 `llmprobe_run` · `llmprobe_calib`；slot 无；service 无 - 组合行 id：`agent-llm-probe` - **Fabric manifest**：`dsh-plugin.json`（RFC 0001 v0.1 **Draft** 形状）——`id` = `com.jonah791.llm-probe`，required = （无），optional = （无） - **Fabric 入口**：`src/fabric.ts` → `lib/fabric.js`（骨架，**不依赖 DSH/Cordis**；Fabric SDK 发布后填充实现） > ⚠ **不是认证**：Fabric 目前只有文档草案（无正式 schema、无 SDK、无 conformance 套件），因此**不得**声称本插件 > 「通过 Fabric 认证」或「已符合 Fabric 标准」。对齐的是 RFC 0001 的 manifest 形状 + 可机械校验的明文规则； > `dsh-plugin.json` 的 `$schema` 是**自证 draft 的占位**，Phase 0 发布 canonical identifier 后替换。 组合片段（`cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - insert: - id: agent-llm-probe name: dsh-llm-probe config: {} ``` ## 能力边界（诚实声明） 本插件与宿主**同进程、全权限**运行。「能力声明」用于兼容判断、用户确认与审计，**不构成安全沙箱**——不要把它当权限边界。 本插件不导入其他插件或宿主的内部路径（组合优先），也不覆盖别人的内部实现。 ### 两个面，别混淆 - **Fabric 契约面**：`dsh-plugin.json` + `src/fabric.ts`（host entrypoint）。这是**前瞻声明**——Fabric 目前只有 RFC Draft， 没有正式 schema / SDK / conformance 套件，官方 `docs/plugin-development.md` 明示其**尚不能作为依赖或发布目标**； `$schema` 是自证 draft 的 `.invalid` 占位（RFC §14-1 未定 canonical identifier），**不是** schema 校验通过，也**不是**认证。 - **DSH/Cordis 面（非标准扩展路径）**：`src/index.ts` + `cordis.patch.yml`——本插件**现在真正可运行**的形态。 `tools` 不在 Fabric v0.1 的 capability 表内（v0.1 只有 host.info / log / 生命周期取消 + `storage.local` / `commands` / `messages.observe`）， 故这属标准之外的扩展路径：**不得**当作可移植 API，也**不得**成为 Fabric entrypoint 的依赖。 ## 构建与挂载 ```sh pnpm build # 挂载到 web profile（dsh plugin-manager 或 plugin_mount） ``` ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-llm-probe": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-llm-probe" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: agent-llm-probe name: dsh-llm-probe config: {} ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`llmprobe_run {url: "http://127.0.0.1:8095/v1/chat/completions", model: "qwen3.8-27b", prompts: ["1+1="], maxTokens: 8}` → 应返回**读数**（调用数/延迟/字符数/sha256/落盘路径）而**不是模型正文**；给一个不存在的 URL 再试 → 应 `ok:false` + 原因（**不是空结果**）。 ## 配置 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `outDir` | `$DSH_HOME/llm-probe` | JSONL 落盘目录（正文写这里，不进上下文） | ⚠ **端点 URL 无默认值**——必须每次显式给（防误打生产端点）。 ## 落盘与自证 | 文件 | 何时写 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `/

plugins.description: Restores opaque backgrounds on floating panels that the liquid-glass theme (dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine) made translucent — a copy-paste recipe, one selector per plugin.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-glass-opaque-fix 让被液态玻璃主题「玻璃化」的浮层恢复正常的不透明背景。 一个可照抄的样板：**改一处选择器**，就能修好另一个插件与玻璃主题的兼容问题。 > 本项目由 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 智能体开发。 --- ## 一、问题是什么 液态玻璃主题插件（`dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`）实现「透出壁纸」的方式，是**改写宿主自己的背景别名**。 它的样式表里有一组 `body[data-we-glass-page]` 规则，把宿主的 ``` --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1 --dsw-alias-bg-layer-2 --dsw-alias-bg-layer-3 ``` 重新映射成由 `color-mix(…, transparent)` 合成的**半透明膜**。 **这是主题的正当设计** —— 壁纸正是从这些膜下面透出来的。 **但它是一个全局改动。** 任何**用这些别名画面板**的插件，都会**跟着一起变半透明** —— 哪怕那个插件跟壁纸毫无关系。 ### 后果 | 现象 | 说明 | |---|---| | 浮窗/弹窗变半透明 | 文字压在壁纸上，难以阅读 | | **插件里没有开关可调** | 因为那个插件是按「宿主别名本来不透明」写的 | | 用户无解 | 只能二选一：要么关壁纸，要么忍受看不清 | **这不是谁的 bug，是两个正确设计撞在一起的结果。** 本仓库负责收尾。 --- ## 二、为什么改主题或改插件的设置都没用 我们实测过两条最直觉的路径，**都走不通**。 ### 路径一：找主题的「浮层不透明度」设置 `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` **确实有**「浮层玻璃 · 玻璃透明度」这个设置项（`浮层玻璃·独立配置` / `Popover glass · glass opacity`）。 **但它管不到第三方浮层。** 它的选择器只有三类： ``` body[data-we-glass-floaters] [data-install-registry] ← DSH 官方安装注册面板 body[data-we-glass-floaters] .we-update-notice ← 主题自己的更新提示 body[data-we-glass-floaters] .we-repo-panel ← 主题自己的壁纸仓库 ``` 全是 `we-` 前缀的自家组件，或官方组件。**没有 `[role=dialog]`、没有任何通用匹配** —— 所以第三方浮层不在它管辖范围内。 而且那条滑块在数学上也**到不了不透明**： ```js // wallpaper-engine 1.3.3 const glassAlpha = Math.max(0.10, 0.25 - (selection.glassAlpha / 100) * 0.15); ``` | 滑块 | alpha | 效果 | |---|---|---| | 0 | **0.25** | 最「实」，**但仍 25% 透明** | | 100 | 0.10 | 最透 | **下限锁死在 0.25** —— 这是主题的可读性铁律，不是配置失误。 ### 路径二：改被影响插件的文件 我们最初的做法，是把一条 CSS 规则**打进主题插件的 bundle**： ```css /* 曾经这样修过，现已失效 */ body[data-we-glass-page] .cm-stat-dialog { background: var(--we-panel-color) !important; } ``` **它撑到主题下一次更新就没了** —— 实测 `1.3.2 → 1.3.3` 把这条规则整个抹掉，浮层重新变半透明。 **为什么必然如此**：冲突的两边都是**第三方插件**，**两边都会更新**。 | 补丁位置 | 谁更新会抹掉它 | |---|---| | 主题插件的 `lib/client.js` | **主题**更新 | | 被影响插件的文件 | **被影响插件**更新 | **所以正确的做法是第三个位置：你自己的插件。** 它不属于任何一方，没人会覆盖它。 --- ## 三、修复原理 三步，**每一步都不能少**。 ### 第 1 步：用不会被改写的颜色变量 ``` ❌ var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1) ← 正是被主题改成半透明膜的那个 ✅ var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-00) ← 主题从不赋值，天然不透明 ✅ var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-875) ← 深色版本 ✅ var(--we-panel-color) ← 主题基于上面两个定义，色调更协调 ``` **实测依据**：在 `wallpaper-engine 1.3.3` 的 bundle 里搜索这两个 `--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-*`，**赋值次数为 0** —— 主题不碰它们。 所以它们是**构造上就不透明**的，装不装壁纸都可靠。 本插件用的表达式： ```css background: var(--we-panel-color, var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-00, #ffffff)) !important; ``` 优先用主题的面板色（与周围玻璃同色调），主题不在时退回静态中性色。 ### 第 2 步：加 `!important` **这是必需的，不是习惯性写法。** 主题的令牌映射挂在 `body[data-we-glass-page]` 下，**作用域优先级高于一个裸的 class 选择器**。不加 `!important` 压不过它。 ### 第 3 步：父与子一起写 如果浮层有独立的头部/主体，**它们也要列上**： ```css .cm-stat-dialog, .cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-head, .cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-body { background: … !important; } ``` **原因**：子元素自己的 `background` 会盖在父元素之上。只给父元素设不透明，子元素那块**仍会是半透明的** —— 表现为面板上一条条透光的带。 --- ## 四、怎么用它修另一个插件（给 AI 的操作指南） **整个流程改动的只有一处：`client.js` 里的 `RECIPES` 数组。** ### 步骤 ``` ① 打开那个半透明的浮窗 ② DevTools → Elements → 点选该浮窗 → 读它的 class 属性 ③ 把类名加进 client.js 的 RECIPES（形如 '.that-class'） ④ 重启 DSH（改动 client.js 需要重启才加载） ⑤ 复查：浮窗应不再透出壁纸 ⑥ 若头部/主体仍透光 → 把子元素选择器也加进去 ``` ### 要改的那一处 `client.js` 顶部： ```js const RECIPES = [ { id: 'cost-meter', plugin: 'dsh-cost-meter', note: '费用明细 dialog。已验证 1.8.32。', selectors: [ '.cm-stat-dialog', '.cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-head', '.cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-body', ], }, // ← 在这里加新条目 // { // id: 'some-plugin', // plugin: 'dsh-some-plugin', // note: '设置弹窗；选择器取自 DevTools。', // selectors: ['.some-dialog'], // }, ]; ``` ### 怎么找到正确的选择器 | 目标 | 做法 | |---|---| | 定位浮窗元素 | DevTools → 左上角「选择元素」图标 → 点浮窗 | | 读类名 | 看 `class="…"` 属性，优先选**最外层**那个面板元素 | | 确认它真的透光 | DevTools → Computed → 看 `background-color` 的 alpha 是否小于 1 | | 确认生效 | 加完规则后，看 computed 里 `background-color` 是否变成不透明 | ### 排查：加了规则但没效果 按顺序查这三条： | 检查 | 方法 | |---|---| | **样式注入成功了吗** | DevTools → Elements → 搜 `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-glass-opaque-fix"]`，应能找到 | | **选择器匹配到了吗** | 在 Console 里跑 `document.querySelectorAll('.你的选择器').length`，应 ≥ 1 | | **优先级够吗** | 看 computed 的 `background-color` 值旁有没有被划掉（划掉说明被别的规则赢了） | --- ## 五、已收录的修复用例 | 插件 | 浮层 | 选择器 | 验证状态 | |---|---|---|---| | [`dsh-cost-meter`](https://github.com/) | 费用明细 dialog | `.cm-stat-dialog` + `.cm-stat-dialog-head` + `.cm-stat-dialog-body` | ✅ **实际使用中**（1.8.32） | **关于验证状态的诚实说明**：✅ 表示这条配方在开发机上**实际解决了问题**。其他条目若由他人补充，请在 `note` 里写清验证到哪个版本 —— **本仓库的价值在于配方可靠**，一条没验证过的选择器比没有更糟。 ### 为什么点名这些插件 因为**不点名就没法照抄** —— 「某个插件的某个浮窗」这种描述，AI 和人都无法定位到具体选择器。 **这些插件都没有错。** 半透明是玻璃主题的全局作用域导致的，被影响的插件只是按宿主的正常语义写了样式。本仓库做的是**在第三个位置收尾**，而不是指出谁的缺陷。 --- ## 六、安装 ### 方式一：本地目录（开发/自用推荐） 1. 克隆或用本地副本，放到任意目录 2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加两处： ```jsonc { "dependencies": { "dsh-glass-opaque-fix": "link:A:/你的路径/dsh-glass-opaque-fix" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // … "dsh-glass-opaque-fix" ] } } } ``` 3. 在 `profile/node_modules/` 下建目录链接（Windows 用 Junction）： ```cmd mklink /J "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-glass-opaque-fix" "A:\你的路径\dsh-glass-opaque-fix" ``` 4. **重启 DSH** ### 方式二：复制一个配方，不用装插件 如果你只想修**一个**插件、也不想装东西： 1. 读第四节，找到选择器 2. 把那段 CSS 加进**你自己已有的某个插件**里 3. 或直接加进任意会被加载的样式表 **代价**：以后主题或那个插件更新时，你可能要重新加一遍 —— 这正是本插件把规则独立出来的原因。 ### 环境要求 | 依赖 | 要求 | |---|---| | DSH | 能加载 `dsh.client` 插件的版本 | | 主题插件 | 可选。没装玻璃主题时，本插件不产生可见变化（规则仍注入，但底色本来就是不透明的） | **无需第三方依赖，无构建步骤。** --- ## 七、设计取舍 - **只加规则，不改别人的文件。** 这是它能活过插件更新的**唯一原因**。任何"顺手改一下主题插件"的做法都会回到原来的困境。 - **配方集中在 `RECIPES` 数组里。** 要改的地方只有一处，且改了哪条一目了然 —— 而不是散在几百行 CSS 里。 - **用 `ctx.effect` 绑定生命周期。** 卸载插件时样式随之移除。一个**已删除却仍在改页面**的插件，比它修的问题更糟。 - **没有配方时不注入空 `

# dsh-plugin-persona — DSH 人格管理器

给当前 DSH 客户端提供一套「模型人格（人设 / 人格提示词）」的完整管理：多套自定义人设、**每个会话独立绑定**、默认人格、随时切换（可选择立即生效或下个会话生效），并把同一套能力作为工具暴露给模型自己调用。

- Host 半（`lib/index.js`）：在会话自己的 agent scope 里覆盖 `deployment:persona-prefix` / `deployment:persona-suffix`，注册 HTTP JSON 桥，注册 3 个模型工具。
- Web 客户端半（`lib/client.js`）：设置页「模型人格」+ 输入框左侧的人设切换芯片。

## 功能

**设置页（设置 → 模型人格，`settings.section#persona-manager`，order 25）**

- 人设库：新建 / 编辑（名称、emoji、描述、前缀、后缀）/ 删除，`complete`（独占整个 system prompt）与 `suppressRuntimeContext`（抑制运行时上下文）两个开关。
- 设为默认 / 取消默认（默认人格只决定「没有绑定的会话」用什么）。
- 导入 / 导出 JSON；显示存储路径；显示模型工具注册状态（Host 半如果注册失败，这里会直接给出错误文本）。

**输入框芯片（`conversation.input.left#persona-manager.switcher`，order 120）**

- 一眼看到当前会话生效的人格（emoji + 名字，`跟随默认` / `临时文本` 也会显示出来）。
- 下拉即可切换：跟随默认、任选人设、`临时文本…`（只作用于本会话的一次性人格）、`仅对下一个会话生效`（只记账、不重注入，因此不动当前 KV 前缀）、`立即重注入`。

**模型工具（Host 半注册，模型可自行调用）**

- `persona_list` — 列出所有人设，并说明本会话当前生效的是哪个。
- `persona_switch` — 切换本会话人格；参数 `id` / `custom`（临时文本）/ `deferred`（true = 下次会话生效）。
- `persona_create` — 新建并保存一个可复用的人设。

**HTTP JSON 桥（客户端半使用，也可以脚本直接调）**

- `GET /dsh-persona/api/state?sessionId=<id>` → 完整视图（人设库、默认、本会话绑定、生效结果、`active`、`tools` 注册状态、`storePath`）。
- `POST /dsh-persona/api/call`，body `{"method": "...", "params": {...}}`，方法：`state` `create` `update` `remove` `setDefault` `switch` `activate` `import` `export`。失败返回 4xx + `{"ok":false,"error":"..."}`。

## 安装

推荐走 DSH 插件管理（需要 danger-full-access 或逐次批准）：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本目录的绝对路径>
```

它会 `pnpm link` 进 profile 并把包名写进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，同时激活 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 Loader 行 `persona-manager`。

也可以手动安装：把本目录放进（或链接到）profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-plugin-persona`，再在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加入 `"dsh-plugin-persona"`。

## 生效时机与 KV 缓存（重要）

- **只绑定 / 立即生效**：`switch` 默认只写绑定（下个会话或下个 agent 才生效）；`activate` 或界面上的「立即重注入」才会改写当前会话正在用的提示词。
- DSH 的 system prompt 走 `systemPromptUpdate: 'in-history'`：提示词变化会**追加在已缓存历史之后**，所以「立即生效」不会破坏已有前缀的缓存复用；代价是旧人格文本会留在历史里，直到 compaction 把它压掉。
- **重新加载**：客户端半（`lib/client.js`）的改动由 client-hmr 轮询自动热更新，刷新页面即可看到；Host 半（`lib/index.js` 等）的改动**必须重启 DSH 进程**（Node ESM 缓存，加载器不带 cache-busting 查询串）。

## 数据

- 默认 `$DSH_HOME/persona/personas.json`，可用环境变量 `DSH_PERSONA_STORE` 覆盖。
- 结构：`{version: 1, defaultId: string|null, personas: Persona[], bindings: {[sessionId]: {personaId?: string, custom?: string}}}`。
- 上限：200 条人设、名称 64 字符、单段文本 64 KiB、请求体 1 MiB。
- 写入是原子的（临时文件 + fsync + rename），读取永不抛（坏文件/缺失都当空库处理）。
- 首次运行会种入 3 个内置人设：精简架构师 / 严格评审员 / 耐心的讲解者。

## 实现要点（为什么这样做）

- DSH 的 `systemPrompt` **没有「改文本」接口**，只有 `section()` / `context()` 注册，而且注册是 per-context 的分层覆盖（`ScopedLayers`）。因此插件把人格注册进**该会话自己的 `agent.ctx`**，用它覆盖 preset 带来的人格 section；同一 scope 内重复注册同名 section 会抛错，所以每次切换都**先 dispose 旧的再注册新的**。
- **不能全局注册** persona section：会与 prompt registry 自带的全局 section 冲突并直接报错。
- `agent id === session id`，所以会话绑定直接用 sessionId 当键；新会话在 `agent/created` 时套用（绑定 → 默认 → 什么都不做，跟随 preset），插件被重新加载时也会给已存在的会话补注入一次。
- 不用自定义 session 事件（`SessionEventMap` 是仓库自有的，未知类型在读取时会被拒），也不依赖存储服务，插件自带原子 JSON 存储。
- 客户端半是**手写的 lazy-CJS bundle**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），只 `require` 平台 seed 表里的 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime`；bundle 模型里没有 `ctx.styles` 之类的服务，CSS 用原始 `<style>` 元素在 factory 阶段插入（由 client-modules 的 `claimStyles` 认领，HMR 时能正确回收）。
- 模型工具**不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`**（第三方插件解析不到 app.asar 里的包，会静默失败），改为手写等价对象：标准 JSON Schema 的 `parameters` + `output: {schema, render}`。

## 开发与测试

```bash
node test/check-persona.js    # 语法 + store/runtime 语义（原子写、resolvePersona 优先级、覆盖注册、释放、后缀 order 10200）
node test/verify-host.js      # 驱动真实 HTTP 路由 + 三个模型工具（含 deferred 不改写当前提示词的回归断言）
node test/verify-client.js    # 在假 window/document 里加载 bundle，真的渲染并点按钮，断言发出 switch 调用
npm test                      # 三个一起跑
```

三个 harness 都是纯 Node、无子进程（当前沙箱禁止管道），失败会打印 `FAIL …` 并以非 0 退出。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js        Host 半：HTTP 路由 + 3 个模型工具 + agent 生命周期 + 视图
lib/store.js        原子 JSON 存储、规范化与限额
lib/runtime.js      在 agent scope 内注入/释放 persona section
lib/client.js       Web 客户端半：设置页 + 输入框芯片（手写 bundle）
cordis.patch.yml    注入 Loader 行 persona-manager
test/               check-persona.js / verify-host.js / verify-client.js
```

plugins.description: DSH plugin: use ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription models in DeepSeek Harness via OAuth, no API key.
plugins.readme_text:
# Chatgpt-DSH

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that signs in with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro account
and exposes its ChatGPT models in DSH on the subscription quota. No API key needed.

The plugin package lives in `chatgpt-plus-dsh/`. This repository contains the
package plus top-level documentation; the package directory itself ships only
runtime files.

## How it works

The plugin registers a `chatgpt-plus` provider route with DSH's `llm` service, so
the account's ChatGPT models show up in the DSH model picker. Requests go to the
ChatGPT backend used by the Codex CLI (`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api`), billed
against the ChatGPT subscription rather than API usage.

Sign-in uses OpenAI OAuth (Authorization Code + PKCE S256) with the Codex CLI's
public client. A short-lived listener on `127.0.0.1:1455` receives the redirect;
if that port is busy, the settings page offers a paste-the-URL fallback. The
resulting grant (access, refresh and ID tokens) is kept in DSH's credential store
under `chatgpt-plus/account` and refreshed automatically before it expires.

## Features

- Sign in / sign out with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro account from the DSH settings page.
- Account models listed from the ChatGPT backend, with periodic refresh and usage
  figures shown in the settings UI.
- Streaming chat completions via the Codex Responses endpoint, including tool
  calls and reasoning items where the model returns them.
- Background token refresh plus single-flight refresh shared across concurrent
  requests and DSH processes sharing one home.
- Settings page served from DSH's own web server (same-origin JSON endpoints);
  responses never contain token material.
- Runs alongside `dsh-chatgpt-sub` in one profile: provider route, credential
  key, HTTP prefix and data directory are all distinct.

## Technology stack

- JavaScript (ES modules), Node.js `>= 20.11`.
- Zero runtime dependencies — `lib/` imports only Node built-ins and sibling
  modules. The settings UI (`lib/client.js`) is a module-loader factory using
  `react` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` supplied by the host.
- Tests run on Node's built-in test runner, no test dependencies.
- Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer (`llm.registerAdapter` and
  credential records APIs).

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 20.11 or newer (`node --version`).
- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2+.
- A ChatGPT Plus or Pro account for sign-in.

## Installation

No `npm install` is required — the package declares no dependencies or peers.

1. Place the `chatgpt-plus-dsh/` directory where DSH loads plugins from
   (for example a `link:` install, or `dsh plugin add <path>` — see your DSH
   docs for the exact command in your setup).
2. Add the bundle row to your profile so the plugin is mounted. The stock row
   from `chatgpt-plus-dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: chatgpt-plus
      name: 'chatgpt-plus-dsh'
```

3. Start DSH, open Plugins → ChatGPT Plus, and click **Sign in with ChatGPT**.

Optional row config keys (all may be omitted): `callbackPort`
(OpenAI only accepts `1455` for this client), `signInTimeoutMs`,
`requestTimeoutMs`, `streamIdleTimeoutMs`, `clientVersion`.

## Configuration

There is no `.env` file. Secrets live only in DSH's credential store
(`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, record `chatgpt-plus/account`, file mode 0600);
non-secret preferences and the cached model list live under
`$DSH_HOME/chatgpt-plus-dsh/` (directory 0700, owner-only ACL on Windows).
All tunables are row config keys (see above) with defaults in
`chatgpt-plus-dsh/lib/constants.js` (`DEFAULTS`).

## Running locally

```powershell
node --version            # needs >= 20.11
cd chatgpt-plus-dsh
node tests/run-all.mjs    # offline test suite, no network access
```

To exercise the plugin against a real DSH build, install the package into a DSH
profile as described above and open the ChatGPT Plus settings page.

## Building and testing

There is no build step. The supported check is the offline suite:

```powershell
cd chatgpt-plus-dsh
node tests/run-all.mjs
```

It runs every `tests/*.test.mjs` in its own process and exits non-zero on any
failure. Last verified: 93 passed, 0 failed (Node 24, Windows).

## Project structure

```text
chatgpt-plus-dsh/
  lib/
    index.js       # plugin entry: registers provider route, token lifecycle, settings endpoints
    controller.js  # sign-in flow, token refresh, preferences, usage/model fetching
    provider.js    # `chatgpt-plus` LLM adapter (Codex Responses endpoint)
    oauth.js       # PKCE helpers, token exchange/refresh, grant payload
    models.js      # model catalog fetch, quota/usage parsing
    rpc.js         # same-origin settings-page endpoints
    client.js      # settings page UI (host module-loader factory)
    store.js       # credential-store + $DSH_HOME persistence
    errors.js      # error taxonomy and user-facing messages
    util.js        # file, time and platform helpers
    constants.js   # identifiers, OAuth/backend endpoints, defaults
  tests/           # offline suite (`run-all.mjs` + `*.test.mjs`)
  locale/en.json   # plugin card title/description
  cordis.patch.yml # bundle row mounting the plugin
  package.json     # manifest (no dependencies, no peers)
```

`verify/` (local only, not published) holds sandbox QA harnesses and screenshots.

## Troubleshooting

- **Plugin fails to load with a message about missing APIs**: update DSH to
  0.2.0-rc.2 or newer (`assertHostSupport` in `lib/index.js` names the missing API).
- **Sign-in listener can't bind port 1455**: another process (or a second DSH
  profile signing in) holds it. Use the paste-the-URL fallback the settings page
  shows, or free the port and retry.
- **"Refresh token was rejected" / signed out unexpectedly**: the grant expired
  or was revoked (including by signing in elsewhere, since rotation invalidates
  the old family). Sign in again from the settings page.
- **Requests fail after the token expires though auto-refresh is off**: either
  enable "Refresh tokens automatically" or use "Refresh token now" in
  Plugins → ChatGPT Plus.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: 在deepseekharness中接入豆包语言模型，阅读对话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-doubao-tts

把火山引擎豆包「双向流式语音合成 V3」接进 DSH Web GUI：**每条已定稿的助手回答后面多一个朗读按钮**，点一下就把这条回答合成成语音播出来。

```sh
# 安装（示例用 web profile；桌面版请把 profile 换成 desktop）
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/qin-yu-1314/dsh-doubao-tts

# 本机没有 git 时，改用 Release 里的压缩包：
#   dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/qin-yu-1314/dsh-doubao-tts/releases/latest/download/dsh-doubao-tts-0.2.2.tgz"
```

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 适用 profile | `web` / `desktop`（桌面版由应用内插件页管理） |
| 最低 DSH 版本 | `>= 0.1.5-rc.2`（需要 slot 系统与 `settings.section`） |
| 许可证 | [MIT](LICENSE) |
| 运行时依赖 | 无（自带 WebSocket 实现，安装期不需要 pnpm 拉任何包） |
| 前置条件 | 火山引擎「大模型语音合成」已开通，需要自己的 API Key 或 App ID + Access Key |

装好后到**侧栏「设置」→「豆包语音合成」**填密钥与音色，点「测试合成」验证。

```
浏览器                    DSH 宿主（插件服务端）              火山引擎
┌──────────────┐  GET    ┌──────────────────────────┐  WSS  ┌────────────────┐
│ 朗读按钮      │ ──────► │ /dsh-doubao-tts/speak     │ ────► │ bidirection v3 │
│ <audio> 播放  │ ◄────── │ ① 按 messageId 取正文     │ ◄──── │ 二进制帧 + 音频 │
└──────────────┘ 音频流   │ ② 合成 ③ 落盘缓存         │       └────────────────┘
                          └──────────────────────────┘
```

## 它做什么

- **客户端半边**：往 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` 这个 slot 注入一个朗读按钮（官方反馈插件用的是同一个 slot）。手写 `__ModuleLoader__` bundle，**不需要构建步骤**，只 `require('react')`，不挑宿主版本。
- **服务端半边**：注册 `/dsh-doubao-tts/*` 路由，按火山 v3 **二进制帧协议**合成音频，边收边以 chunked 流式回给浏览器；同一段文本只付费合成一次（落盘缓存）。
- **取正文**：客户端只传 `sessionId` + `messageId`，服务端优先查活会话（`ctx.sessions`），回落读持久化日志 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<slug>/<sessionId>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` —— 并顺手做朗读清洗（丢掉代码块、去掉 Markdown 记号、URL 换成「链接」）。

## 安装

插件包 = 一个声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` 的 npm 包。**本地目录直接装**：

**方式一（推荐，桌面版）**：侧栏「插件」页 → 添加插件 → 填本目录的绝对路径：

```
C:\Users\wllj\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\tts-plugin\dsh-doubao-tts
```

**方式二（CLI，需要先完全退出 DeepSeek Harness Desktop）**：

```powershell
F:\deepseekharness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add "link:C:\Users\wllj\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\tts-plugin\dsh-doubao-tts"
```

**方式三（应用可以开着跑，不需要 pnpm）**：本插件零运行时依赖，所以只差「一个目录联接 + 两处登记」。脚本默认干跑：

```powershell
node tools/install-local.mjs              # 只打印将要改什么
node tools/install-local.mjs --apply      # 真装（改前备份，失败自动回滚）
node tools/install-local.mjs --uninstall --apply   # 卸载
```

装完后：

| 事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 生效方式 | **新增** bundle 由 HMR 热加载，**不必重启进程**；但**浏览器页面要刷新一次**才会拉取新的客户端 bundle |
| 改代码后 | 替换一个**已加载**包的 JS 需要**重启进程**（HMR 只监听 profile 的 manifest / cordis patch，不监听插件自身文件） |
| 页面表现 | 助手消息动作行（复制/分支那一排）最右边出现喇叭图标；未配凭据时点击显示红色提示，而不是静默失败 |
| 挂载位置 | 本仓库目录就是插件安装源（`link:`）。若以后清理工作区，插件会失效——把它复制到固定目录后重装即可 |

> 本机已按方式一装好并验证过：`profiles/desktop/package.json` 里 dependencies 为 `link:C:/…/dsh-doubao-tts`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾含 `dsh-doubao-tts`，`node_modules` 下是 SymbolicLink；`/dsh-doubao-tts/status` 从装前的 404 变成 401（宿主信任栅栏拦匿名请求）、`/probe` 返回插件自己的 405（GET 打到了 POST 路由的分派器）——都证明服务端半边已在宿主进程里注册成功。

## 自检与排障

插件装载后会写一份**不含任何凭据**的自检报告（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\doubao-tts-selfcheck.json`），用来回答「到底装上了没有」：

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `phase: "loaded"` | 服务端半边进了宿主、5+1 条路由注册完毕 |
| `phase: "status-requested"` | **浏览器里的客户端 bundle 执行了**（它装载时就会拉一次 `/status`），`lastStatusRequest.host` 是那次请求的 Host |
| `phase: "client-registered"` | 客户端把按钮**注册进了 slot**；`clientReport.status` 为 `registered` / `register-failed` / `no-slots-service`，失败时带原因 |
| `fence` | 用的是宿主栅栏还是插件自己的回环校验 |
| `configured` / `missing` | 缺哪个凭据字段 |

按钮不出现时，这份报告能区分三种完全不同的原因：客户端 bundle 没加载（停在 `loaded`）、slot 没声明/注册被拒（`register-failed` + 具体错因）、或只是没配凭据（`configured: false`）。

一键核验（重启或重装后跑一次就有结论）：

```powershell
node tools/verify-install.mjs
```

它检查 profile 登记（`link:` 依赖 + `bundles` + 联接可解析）、自检报告的阶段、以及三条路由的匿名探针，并把每个状态码翻译成人话：

| 探针返回 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `404` | 路由不存在 → 插件服务端没加载 |
| `401` | 路由在，但被宿主信任栅栏拦下（匿名请求本就不该通过，**这是正常的**） |
| `405` | 路由在，且打到了插件自己的方法分派器（GET 打 POST 路由） |
| `200` | 路由在且放行 |

> 早期版本会按宿主 cwd 把自检报告写在 `profiles/desktop/` 目录里；**以 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\doubao-tts-selfcheck.json` 为准**，旧路径那份可以删掉。

## 配置凭据

复制 `volc_tts.env.example` 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\volc_tts.env` 并填写（或改用环境变量）：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `VOLC_API_KEY` | 新版 API Key（与下面一对二选一） |
| `VOLC_APP_ID` + `VOLC_ACCESS_TOKEN` | 老版一对密钥；也接受 `VOLC_ACCESS_KEY` |
| `VOLC_RESOURCE_ID` | **必须与音色所属商品一致**，否则报 `55000000`：合成 2.0 音色用 `seed-tts-2.0`，1.0 公版用 `volc.service_type.10029` |
| `VOLC_SPEAKER` | 音色 ID，控制台音色列表里复制 |

凭据在[火山引擎控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/) → 语音技术 → 大模型语音合成 → 开通管理里获取。改完配置**不用重启**（配置有 5 秒缓存），直接验证：

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-doubao-tts/probe -Method POST -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -Expand Content
```

`{"ok":true,"ms":…,"bytes":…}` 就说明通道打通了；失败会回可执行的错误说明（错误码已翻译成中文提示）。

## 路由

| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/status` | GET | 配置是否齐全、音色、格式、缓存统计、日志根目录、`capabilities`（服务端能力清单） |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/settings` | GET/POST | 设置界面用：GET 回显（**密钥只回掩码**）+ 生效值/来源/缓存；POST 原地改写 env 文件 |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/speak` | GET/POST | `?sessionId=&messageId=` 或 `?sessionId=&seq=[&turn=]` 或 `?text=`；返回音频。支持 `voice` `format` `clean=0` `download=1` |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/probe` | POST | 用一句测试文本真实合成一次，验证凭据/音色/网络 |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/client-report` | GET | 客户端半边回执注册结果（落进自检报告） |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/cache` | GET | 缓存条数与占用 |
| `/dsh-doubao-tts/cache-clear` | POST | 清空缓存 |

## 设置界面

**侧栏「设置」→「豆包语音合成」**（挂在 `settings.section` 槽，与「通用」「模型」并列）：

| 分组 | 可改项 |
|---|---|
| 鉴权 | API Key / App ID / Access Key / Access Token（密钥是密码框，只显示掩码占位；**留空 = 不修改**） |
| 音色 | Resource ID（下拉：`seed-tts-2.0` / `volc.service_type.10029`）、音色 ID（可手填，下拉给参考值） |
| 音频 | 格式（mp3/pcm/ogg_opus）、采样率、语速、音量 |
| 连接 | WebSocket 端点、是否先发 StartConnection |
| 按钮 | 保存 / 测试合成 / 重新读取 / 清除已保存的密钥 / 清空音频缓存 |
| 状态 | 是否已配置、缺哪些字段、缓存条数与占用、**配置来源文件**、以及会覆盖它的系统环境变量 |

设计要点：

- **写回原文件**：改的是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\volc_tts.env` 本身，**保留注释、行序与其他键**，只动对应的行（先写 `.tmp` 再 rename，原子写）。
- **密钥不回明文**：GET 只回 `{set:true, masked:"••••••••5f53"}`；输入框永远为空、掩码只当占位符，所以保存时不会把掩码写回文件。
- **立即生效**：保存后服务端立刻清掉配置缓存，不用重启、不用刷新页面。
- **能力协商**：客户端 bundle 刷新页面就更新，服务端代码要重启进程才换。`/status` 的 `capabilities` 用来判断当前服务端支持什么，避免「新界面调旧接口」的静默失败。


### 为什么挂两个 slot

| slot | 位置 | 可见性 | 定位参数 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` | 复制/分支那一排图标里 | **默认 `opacity: 0`，悬停才淡入**（ui-chat 的 `[data-actions-reveal=hover]`） | `messageId` |
| `conversation.chat.turnTail` | 同一节点的兄弟 slot | **常显** | `seq`（该助手消息的事件序号）+ `turn` |

只挂第一个等于把入口藏起来（实测反馈「看不到喇叭图标」）；而且**当某一轮正在生成时**，`data-actions-reveal` 会退化成 `hover`（`endsWithResponse` 要求它是时间线上最后一轮），连最近一轮的动作行也要悬停才出现，甚至当前轮根本不渲染动作行。所以第二个 slot 才是真正的入口——它拿不到 `messageId`，只能拿 `seq`，服务端因此也支持按 `seq` 取正文。

`/status` 的 `capabilities` 用于协商：客户端 bundle 随页面刷新立刻更新，而服务端代码要重启进程才换，存在「新客户端 + 旧服务端」的窗口期；此时常显按钮会显示「需要重启一次 DSH」，而不是发一个注定 400 的请求。

错误码：`400 MISSING_PARAMS`、`404 MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND`（附已知 messageId 便于排障）、`404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND`、`422 EMPTY_TEXT`（只有 reasoning/工具调用、没有正文）、`503 NO_CREDENTIALS`、`502 VOLC_ERROR`（带火山原始错误码）、`502 AUTH_FAILED`（上游拒绝密钥，带服务端原话）、`504 ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE`（连不上火山）。

命令行（不开 GUI）：

```powershell
node tools/probe.mjs                                    # 探针：验证凭据/端点
node tools/probe.mjs --api-key bogus                    # 故意用假密钥，看服务端如何拒绝
node tools/speak-message.mjs --out reply.mp3            # 自动挑最近一条助手消息朗读
node tools/speak-message.mjs --session <id> --seq <n>   # 走 seq 通路（常显按钮同一条路）
node tools/speak-message.mjs --text "你好" --out a.mp3
```

## 真机验证结果（本机）

| 验证项 | 证据 |
|---|---|
| 装进 profile | `dependencies` 为 `link:C:/…/dsh-doubao-tts`，`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾含包名，`node_modules` 下是符号链接且 `entry.js`/`client/doubao-tts.js` 均可解析 |
| 服务端半边装载 | 装前 `/dsh-doubao-tts/status` 是 **404**，装后是 **401**（宿主栅栏拦匿名请求）；`/probe` 返回插件自己的 **405**（GET 打到 POST 路由的分派器） |
| 客户端半边执行 | 自检报告（宿主 pid 36204）在装载后 **0.06 秒**就记录了来自 `127.0.0.1:19387` 的 `/status` 请求——这个请求只由客户端 bundle 发起 |
| **控件注册成功** | 自检报告 `clientReport.status = "registered"`，`slot = conversation.chat.assistant-actions`，`error = null` |
| 真实火山端点 | 用假密钥打生产端点：`HTTP 401 — {"error":"Invalid X-Api-Key"}`，125ms 返回 → 端点路径、DNS/TLS、WS 升级、请求头全部正确 |
| **真实语音合成** | 真密钥下：握手序列 `ConnectionStarted ← SessionStarted ← TTSSentenceStart ← TTSSentenceEnd ← SessionFinished`；20 字 → 11 段 / 30765 字节 / 1.5s；77 字 → 36 段 / 114285 字节 / 2.7s；产物为合法 MP3（ID3v2.4 + MPEG 帧同步） |
| 两条取正文通路一致 | `messageId` 与 `seq` 两条通路在同一会话上解析出**逐字相同**的正文（`speak-message.mjs` 内置交

plugins.description: SessionRelay 生态 · AI 项目记忆层：DSH 插件 + ZCode 适配器 + 核心库（本地优先 · 零神经网络 · 离线可用）
plugins.readme_text:
# SessionRelay 生态 · AI 项目记忆层

> **让你的 AI 记住这个项目**：决策、未决问题、最近在动的东西，在你开口之前就摆到它面前。
> 本地优先 · 零神经网络 · 完全离线可用 · 一个项目一个库。

本项目是 [SessionRelay](https://github.com/EwanJasper/SessionRelay)（MIT）的**独立演进版**——已不跟随上游，外加**三端集成**（DSH / ZCode / Codex），
一个仓库装下全部内容。

---

## ⬇️ 先看你用哪个客户端，就下哪个

| 你在用什么 | 下载 | 干什么用的 | 大小 | 要 trust 吗 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** | **dsh-plugin-0.2.3.zip** | 每轮自动把项目简报注入 system prompt + 图形面板 | ~21MB（自带运行时） | 否 |
| **ZCode** | **zcode-adapter-1.0.2.zip** | 开场简报 + **每轮相关召回**（SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit） | ~32KB | 否 |
| **Codex** | **codex-adapter-1.0.0.zip** | 开场简报 + 13 个 MCP 工具 + 交接技能 | ~35KB | **是** |
| DSH 想要**图形面板** | **dsh-panel-0.1.0.zip** | 记忆台：图谱（可拖拽）/ 看板 / 经验 / 28 个旋钮 | ~0.3MB | 否 |
| 全都用 / 新机器一次装齐 | **ses-offline-\<日期\>.zip** | 全家桶：内核产物 + 插件 + 适配器 + 技能 + 工具 | ~20MB | — |

这些包都在 **[Releases](https://github.com/rui08984-dot/sessionrelay-eco/releases/latest)** 页。
**所有客户端都还需要内核**（记忆本体）——从源码装一次即可，见下面「三分钟装上」。
想直接读源码的话，monorepo 里对应 `packages/dsh-plugin` / `packages/dsh-panel` / `packages/zcode-adapter` / `packages/codex-adapter`。

> **面板用户先看这条**：`dsh-panel` 是**独立的第二件东西**，装 DSH 插件不会自动带上它。
> 它需要 DSH 插件已经装好（面板从插件的 `vendor/dist/srelay.js` 取数），然后单独装面板、再重启 DSH。
> 不装它的症状是「DSH 里没有『记忆台』图标」—— 插件本身完全正常。

> **Codex 用户先看这条**：装完还必须在 Codex 里输入 `/hooks` 手动 trust 一次，钩子才会运行。
> 不 trust 的症状是「装好了但什么都没注入」—— 不是坏了，是还没批准。
> 这是 Codex 的安全设计，脚本无法代劳（详见包内 `README-INSTALL.md`）。

### 傻瓜式安装（每端三步）

**DSH 用户**

1. 下载 `dsh-plugin-0.2.2.zip`，解压
2. 把 `dsh-plugin/` 整个目录复制到 `<你的 DSH 配置目录>/profiles/<profile>/local-plugins/dsh-srelay-brief/`
3. **重启 DSH** → 新开会话，开场应出现 📋 看板 / 决策行

（Windows 上 DSH 配置目录一般在 `C:/Users/<你>/.dsh/`；profile 常见是 `web` 或 `desktop`。）
包内 `README-INSTALL.md` 有同一份步骤 + 排障表。

**ZCode 用户**

1. 下载 `zcode-adapter-1.0.2.zip`，解压
2. 在解压出来的 `zcode-adapter/` 里跑两条命令：

```bash
node install.mjs            # 先看计划，不写任何东西（dry-run）
node install.mjs --apply    # 真装：拷文件 + 注册 SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit 两个 hook
```

3. 在真实项目目录里跑一次 `brief.mjs` 验收，或直接新开会话看有没有 📍项目状态简报

（安装器会**先备份**你的 ZCode 配置，失败了能精确恢复。）

---

## 它解决什么问题

命令行 AI（ZCode、Claude Code…）的工作目录天然等于项目根，开场读一次项目状态是顺手的事；
**桌面端 AI（DSH）三条常规信号全断**——你换个窗口继续干活，它对项目既有的决策一无所知。

更麻烦的是**静默半失效**：装了一个看起来正常的记忆插件，命令成功、库建好了、自检全绿——
而你的会话**永远采不进来，全程零报错**。这个仓库里几乎每一处设计，
都是被这类「绿着的坏」逼出来的（详见 [docs/ENGINEERING-NOTES.md](docs/ENGINEERING-NOTES.md)）。

## 三个核心能力

**1. 每轮自动带上项目简报**（DSH 侧）
不是写死在文件里，而是**每个模型步骤前现查一次记忆库**——这一轮你做的决定，下一轮它就知道。
简报限 1200 字符，走 SQL 直查：冷路径约 5ms，而调 CLI 子进程要 310–360ms。

**2. 开场自动注入**（ZCode 侧）
SessionStart hook 组装简报塞进会话开场。任何失败 = 空输出 = 不阻塞会话。

**3. 一个项目一个库，永不合并**
`<项目>/.sessionrelay/relay.sqlite`，SQLite + FTS5，中文分词（jieba / bigram 可选）。
隐私边界就是文件边界：删掉目录即彻底消失。

---

## 三分钟装上（源码方式）

> 完整步骤（含离线、沙箱验证、卸载回滚）：**[INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)**

```bash
# 1) 内核：装到全局（三个客户端共用）
cd packages/core && npm install && npm run build && npm i -g .

# 2) 给某个项目建记忆库
cd /path/to/your-project && srelay init

# 3) 选你的端（见上面「傻瓜式安装」）
```

**完全离线**（新机器、无 npm、无网络）：用 Release 里的全家桶，见 [release/README.md](release/README.md)。

---

## 仓库结构

```
packages/core/            核心库（TypeScript）：采集 → 提取 → 检索 → 归档 → MCP
packages/dsh-plugin/      DSH 插件（vendor 由 Release 包提供）
packages/zcode-adapter/   ZCode SessionStart hook + 一键安装器
skills/handoff-atlas/     交接与全资源地图技能（含锚点审计、地图生成器）
tools/                    安装器 / 重建 / 一致性守门 / 召回探针 / 客户端打包
docs/                     架构、工程笔记、常见问题
release/                  离线包与客户端包说明、发布清单
```


## 全局经验层（🌍 跨项目经验）

> 记忆原本是**一个项目一个库**——你在 A 项目踩的坑，B 项目完全不知道。
> 经验层补上这一块：**跨项目、有出处、会挑轻重、还会退休**的`老手经验本`。

### 它收什么

| ✅ 收 | ❌ 不收 |
|---|---|
| 环境/工具的事实（本机 pnpm 必须 ≥10.34） | 一次性的具体状态（`今天改了 db.ts`——那是项目记忆的活） |
| **踩过的坑 + 判据**（自动推翻实测误配 87%，别再试） | 主观评价、未验证的推测 |
| 操作配方（改完必须跑 X） | 密钥/凭证（只存`去哪儿找`，**永不存值**） |
| 跨项目都成立的口径（数字必须绑快照与口径） | 模型自己的感想 |

### 四道闸（越往上越权威）

| 闸 | 判据 | 不过会怎样 |
|---|---|---|
| **闸 0 出处**（准入） | 必须挂得上可核验出处：真实工具调用记录 / 用户原话逐字 / 文件内容 | 降为 `inferred`，**只能当草稿，永不进注入层** |
| **闸 1 定级** | `verified-tool` 9.0 / `verified-user` 7.5 / `verified-file` 6.0；阈值 5.5 | 沉到线下（**仍可搜到**，不删） |
| **闸 2 相关性** | 要与本轮**具体**重合（命中标识符或实词）；**常用词不算数** | 不注入 |
| **闸 3 人工确认** | `draft` → `verified`，**只有人能升** | **不许升作用域** |

**`不能随便入库`的落地**：模型自动产的一律 `draft`（**不进注入层**，等于候审）；
升 `verified` 只有两条路——**证据到位** 或 **人工确认**；升作用域必须人工确认；**永不自动删**（退休只是不再默认注入）。

### 作用域

| 作用域 | 谁看得见 | 怎么产生 |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | 只有本工作区 | **默认** |
| `domain` | 同领域标签的项目 | 需证据（同领域 ≥2 个工作区各自确认过） |
| `global` | 所有项目 | 只有显式升级 |

### 用法

```bash
SRELAY_GLOBAL_HOME=~/.sessionrelay srelay lesson add "<一句话经验>" --source <出处> --grade verified-user --scope global
srelay lesson list              # ● 可进注入层 / ○ 已退休（仍可搜）
srelay lesson search <关键词>    # 换词能命中（复用项目同一套分词器）
srelay lesson harvest           # 从项目记忆里刨候选（**只产草稿**）
srelay lesson confirm <id...>   # 人工复核：确认即证据（inferred → verified-file 6.0）
srelay lesson maintain          # 年龄衰减 / 退休 / 复活
srelay lesson export            # 导出 Markdown（人可读、可 git、可手改）
```

### 注入预算（各端不同，都不挤占简报）

| 端 | 时机 | 预算 |
|---|---|---|
| **ZCode** | `SessionStart` 开场 | 按**重要度**给最重要的几条（开场还没有`本轮`可言） |
| **ZCode** | `UserPromptSubmit` **每轮** | 按**相关性**筛（经验 ≤200 字符 / 旧决策 ≤2 条）；**没命中就整段不出现** |
| **DSH** | 每个模型步骤前 | 按重要度给 ≤200 字符 / ≤3 条 |

### 检索排序：多路融合

候选很多、但注入只放得下几条 —— 决定`放哪几条`的是**融合排序**：
三条路各报一份名单（FTS 主路 / 改写路 / 不走分词器的子串路），按 `Σ w/(60+rank)` 合成一份，
**被越多路认、且在各自名单越靠前，就越可信**。长度惩罚进到**每条路内部**（巨型会话在每条路上都是第一名，事后乘系数改不动）。

实测（129 条/臂）：hit@1 **+1.5~7.0 个百分点**、hit@3 +1.5~4.6；hit@10 −1.5~3.9（用尾部换头部，对注入场景正合适）。
复跑：`npx tsx core/SessionRelay/scripts/recall-bench.ts <库路径> --n 150`。
## 实测数字（不是宣传语）

| 项 | 数字 | 怎么来的 |
|---|---|---|
| 简报取数 | 冷路径 **~5ms** / 热路径 ~1ms | SQL 直查 vs CLI 子进程 310–360ms |
| 单库规模 | 583 会话 / 43,253 条消息 | 真实项目库 |
| 关键词检索命中 | **20/20** 进 top-10 | `tools/ses-recall-probe.mjs` 20 问基准 |
| 大白话检索命中 | 17/20 进 top-10（**top-1 仅 10/20**） | 同上——这是本项目的已知短板，写在明处 |
| 提取规则版本 | EXTRACT_VERSION = **18** | 每次改规则都要能重算存量 |
| 一致性守门 | A–I **九段全绿** | `tools/check-versions.mjs` |

## 与上游的关系

上游骨架（旁路捕获 / 规则提取 / SQLite+FTS5 / 三反幻觉 / 删除权在人）**一行没动**，全部是增量：
DSH 适配器、第六采集源 `dsh`、自动归档、提取质量八层防线、跨端简报、项目判定、
`srelay doctor` 体检、多副本一致性守门。

**不追求与上游合并**——本项目按自有仓库独立发展。上游版权与许可完整保留（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。

## 许可

MIT。上游 © EwanJasper，本仓库改造部分 © rui08984-dot。

plugins.description: Agent tools and a loopback REST API for DSH session housekeeping: list, move across workspaces, delete with backup, tag, archive and unarchive.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager

Agent tools and a loopback REST API for DSH session housekeeping — list, move across workspaces, delete with an optional backup, tag, archive and unarchive.

DSH's own GUI covers only part of this surface (it can archive, but not unarchive; it has no tags; cross-workspace moves need a restart). This plugin puts the whole surface on two rails that share one implementation:

- **Agent tools** — six tools the model can call directly.
- **Loopback REST API** — the same six operations over HTTP, so a browser plugin can drive them without an IPC bridge. [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) uses this to render tags, drag-and-drop and the archive menu in the sidebar.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Runtime | Node.js 22+ (ships with the DSH desktop runtime) |

Earlier DSH releases are untested. The plugin reads `workspaceRegistry`, `sessionPersistence`, `storageDomain` and `webServer`; a release that renames or removes any of those will make the corresponding feature fail soft (logged as a warning) rather than crash the host.

## Install

```bash
# from git (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-session-manager

# or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-manager
```

`<your-profile>` is the profile you actually boot — `desktop` for the Electron app, `web` / `headless` / `node` for the CLI modes. The `desktop` profile is managed by the Electron app and refuses `dsh` CLI writes while the app is running; install into it from the app's own plugin manager, or close the app first.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` also appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loader mounts it on the next start. If you installed by hand, add the row yourself:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: session-manager
      name: 'dsh-session-manager'
```

## Agent tools

All six take JSON arguments and return `{ ok: true, ... }` or `{ ok: false, error }`.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `session_list` | Enumerate persisted sessions with workspace, archive state, tags and title. Filters: `workspaceId`, `path`, `archived`, `tag`. |
| `session_move` | Move sessions across workspaces. Rewrites the log header `cwd` and renames the directory on disk, then updates the registry live — the GUI reflects it without a restart. |
| `session_delete` | Permanently delete sessions and their log directories. Pass `backupDir` to copy each directory first. |
| `session_tag` | `set` / `add` / `remove` / `clear` / `drop` / `list` tags. Stored in `~/.dsh/session-tags.json`. |
| `session_archive` | Hide a session from every grouping surface; log and workspace slot preserved. Idempotent. |
| `session_unarchive` | Restore an archived session to its original position — the direction the GUI is missing. |

Live sessions (the conversation the model is currently running in) are refused by `session_move` and `session_delete`.

## REST API

Registered only when the `webServer` service is present (the `web` and `desktop` modes). Every handler funnels through the corresponding tool's `execute`, so both surfaces behave identically.

Every request is fenced by `isLoopbackRequest(req)` — a non-loopback peer gets `403 {"error":"forbidden: loopback-only"}`. There is no token; the fence is the transport, not a credential. Do not expose the DSH web server beyond localhost while this plugin is mounted.

| Method | Path | Body / query |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions` | — |
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | — |
| `PUT` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | `{ "sessionId": "...", "tags": ["a","b"] }` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/tags` | `{ "tags": ["a"] }` — drops those tags from every session |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/move` | `{ "sessionIds": [...], "targetWorkspaceId": "..." }` or `{ ..., "targetPath": "...", "createIfMissing": true }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/delete` | `{ "sessionIds": [...], "backupDir": "..." }` (`backupDir` optional) |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/archive` | `{ "sessionId": "..." }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/sessions/unarchive` | `{ "sessionId": "..." }` |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-manager/projcache/warm` | — (diagnostics: returns the title warm-up report) |

Status codes: `200` when the tool returned `ok: true`, `400` for a business failure or a malformed body, `403` off-loopback, `405` wrong method, `500` unexpected throw.

Request bodies are capped at 1 MB and must be JSON objects.

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-session-manager/tags
curl -s -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-session-manager/tags \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"sessionId":"abc123","tags":["research","todo"]}'
```

## Behaviour worth knowing

**Moves keep three things in sync.** The physical move (zstd header rewrite plus directory rename) is followed by a registry header re-index and the public `attachSession` / `detachSession` calls, and the projection cache's `identity.cwd` is updated through the storage-domain table handle. Skipping any of the three leaves the GUI showing a stale path.

**Titles are pre-warmed at startup.** `session.list` carries no title for a cold session; the durable title lives in the projection-cache checkpoint, which is only written when a session was attached in some process. After a restart every unopened session is cold and the sidebar falls back to the directory basename. 800 ms after mount the plugin walks persisted sessions lacking a title row and calls the official `coldSnapshot(meta, inheritedEventCount, events)` to write the checkpoint back.

The tail probe that validates an existing title row is **off** (`WARM_TAIL_PROBE = false` in `lib/index.js`). With it on, every start re-read the log tail of all sessions — the dominant cost of a slow sidebar after a restart, at roughly 620 sessions. The trade-off: a rename that happened during a projection-cache write failure window is no longer corrected at startup; the official cold-read ladder still heals it when the session is opened. Set the constant to `true` to restore the old behaviour.

**Archive goes through the registry.** Archiving funnels through `archiveSession()` — the same add-only API the GUI uses. The plugin never rewrites the archive set except on an explicit delete or unarchive, and even then it goes through the registry's public `enqueueOperation` / `setState` write chain so the registry's cached state stays coherent.

**Zero imports by design.** `lib/index.js` uses only `node:` builtins. The file plugin is loaded by native dynamic import, so a bare specifier would have to resolve from the profile's `node_modules`; the builtin-only rule keeps it loadable as a standalone file plugin (the same shape as `zen-useragent.js`).

## Companion plugins

- [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) — the sidebar UI (tags, grouping, drag-to-move, delete) that consumes this REST API. It replaces the official `ui-workspace` bundle, so disable that row when both are installed.
- [`dsh-session-query-vector`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-query-vector) — semantic session search backend.
- [`dsh-session-search`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-search) — in-conversation find bar.
- [`dsh-ui-reload`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload) — one-click frontend reload button.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s
